pub fn add_source_notes(report:&mut Report,sources:&[(String,String)],bound:&Bound){
    report.notes.extend(lints::source_notes(sources,bound));
    report.notes.extend(write_advice::notes(sources,bound));
    report.notes.extend(creation_advice::notes(sources,bound));
    report.notes.extend(result_advice::notes(bound));
    let mut sites=BTreeMap::new();
    for (file,source) in sources{let (doc,_)=crate::parse_document(file,source);for t in doc.tables{
        sites.insert(t.name.clone(),t.site.clone());for c in t.columns{sites.insert(format!("{}.{}",t.name,c.name),c.site);}
        for r in t.rules{sites.insert(format!("{}.{}",t.name,r.effect.word()),r.site);}
    }}
    for note in &mut report.notes{if note.site.line==0 {
        let key=note.message.split([' ',':']).next().unwrap_or("");
        note.site=sites.get(key).or_else(||sites.get(key.split('.').next().unwrap_or(""))).cloned().unwrap_or_else(||Site::new(sources.first().map(|s|s.0.as_str()).unwrap_or("schema.q"),1,1));
    }}
}
//! Advisory lineage through compiled result/refusal expressions, never a proof.
// @ref LLP 3000.036.004#152-mutation-results-are-observations — projection is one observer, not a privacy boundary.
use super::*;
use snapback4_core::ir::{self,Expr,Stmt};
type Sources=BTreeSet<(String,String)>;
#[derive(Clone,Default)]
struct Flow{sources:Sources,fields:BTreeMap<String,Flow>}
impl Flow{
    fn all(&self)->Sources{self.sources.iter().cloned().chain(self.fields.values().flat_map(Flow::all)).collect()}
    fn union(xs:impl IntoIterator<Item=Flow>)->Self{Self{sources:xs.into_iter().flat_map(|f|f.all()).collect(),fields:BTreeMap::new()}}
    fn join(mut a:Flow,b:Flow)->Flow{a.sources.extend(b.sources);for(n,v)in b.fields{let old=a.fields.remove(&n).unwrap_or_default();a.fields.insert(n,Self::join(old,v));}a}
}
fn row(bound:&Bound,table:&str)->Flow{Flow{sources:Sources::new(),fields:bound.schema.tables.get(table).map(|t|t.columns.keys().map(|c|(c.clone(),Flow{sources:BTreeSet::from([(table.into(),c.clone())]),fields:BTreeMap::new()})).collect()).unwrap_or_default()}}
fn value(bound:&Bound,e:&Expr,env:&mut BTreeMap<String,Flow>,reads:&mut BTreeSet<String>,returned:&mut Sources,refusals:&mut Sources)->Flow{match e{
    Expr::Variable(n)=>env.get(n).cloned().unwrap_or_default(),
    Expr::Field{base,name}=>{let f=value(bound,base,env,reads,returned,refusals);f.fields.get(name).cloned().unwrap_or(Flow{sources:f.sources,fields:BTreeMap::new()})},
    Expr::Object(fields)=>Flow{sources:Sources::new(),fields:fields.iter().map(|(n,v)|(n.clone(),value(bound,v,env,reads,returned,refusals))).collect()},
    Expr::Shape{base,fields}=>{let _=value(bound,base,env,reads,returned,refusals);Flow{sources:Sources::new(),fields:fields.iter().map(|(n,v)|(n.clone(),value(bound,v,env,reads,returned,refusals))).collect()}},
    Expr::Get(r)=>{reads.insert(r.table.clone());row(bound,&r.table)},
    Expr::Scan(s)=>{reads.insert(s.table.clone());row(bound,&s.table)},
    Expr::Merge(m)=>{reads.insert(m.table().into());row(bound,m.table())},
    Expr::Array(xs)|Expr::Builtin{args:xs,..}=>{
        // ProjectFields is the engine's column gate, retaining row identity.
        if let Expr::Builtin{builtin:ir::Builtin::ProjectFields{table},..}=e{
            reads.insert(table.clone());let input=xs.first().map(|e|value(bound,e,env,reads,returned,refusals)).unwrap_or_default();return Flow::join(input,row(bound,table));
        }
        if let Expr::Builtin{builtin:ir::Builtin::OptionalField{field,..},..}=e{
            let f=value(bound,&xs[0],env,reads,returned,refusals);return f.fields.get(field).cloned().unwrap_or(Flow{sources:f.sources,fields:BTreeMap::new()});
        }
        if matches!(e,Expr::Builtin{builtin:ir::Builtin::ProjectFields{..}|ir::Builtin::RequireUncapped|ir::Builtin::First|ir::Builtin::Last|ir::Builtin::At|ir::Builtin::Sort{..},..})&&!xs.is_empty(){return value(bound,&xs[0],env,reads,returned,refusals);}
        Flow::union(xs.iter().map(|e|value(bound,e,env,reads,returned,refusals)))
    },
    Expr::Binary{left,right,..}=>{
        let a=value(bound,left,env,reads,returned,refusals);let b=value(bound,right,env,reads,returned,refusals);
        if matches!(&**left,Expr::Literal(snapback4_core::Value::Null))&&!b.fields.is_empty()||matches!(&**right,Expr::Literal(snapback4_core::Value::Null))&&!a.fields.is_empty(){Flow::default()}else{Flow::union([a,b])}
    },
    Expr::Unary{value:e,..}=>value(bound,e,env,reads,returned,refusals),
    Expr::Block{body,value:e}=>{statements(bound,body,env,reads,returned,refusals);value(bound,e,env,reads,returned,refusals)},
    _=>Flow::default(),
}}
fn statements(bound:&Bound,body:&[Stmt],env:&mut BTreeMap<String,Flow>,reads:&mut BTreeSet<String>,returned:&mut Sources,refusals:&mut Sources){for s in body{match s{
    Stmt::Const{name,value:e}|Stmt::Let{name,value:e}|Stmt::Assign{name,value:e}=>{let f=value(bound,e,env,reads,returned,refusals);env.insert(name.clone(),f);},
    Stmt::Push{target,value:e}=>{let f=value(bound,e,env,reads,returned,refusals);let old=env.remove(target).unwrap_or_default();env.insert(target.clone(),Flow::union([old,f]));},
    Stmt::Insert{table,row:Expr::Variable(n)}|Stmt::InsertIfAbsent{table,row:Expr::Variable(n),..}=>{let prior=env.remove(n).unwrap_or_default();env.insert(n.clone(),Flow::join(prior,row(bound,table)));},
    Stmt::WriteTarget{target,result:Some(n),..}=>{reads.insert(target.table.clone());env.insert(n.clone(),row(bound,&target.table));},
    Stmt::Return(e)=>{returned.extend(value(bound,e,env,reads,&mut Sources::new(),refusals).all());},
    Stmt::Require{condition,..}|Stmt::Check{condition,..}=>{refusals.extend(value(bound,condition,env,reads,returned,&mut Sources::new()).all());},
    Stmt::If{condition,then_body,else_body}=>{
        let condition=value(bound,condition,env,reads,returned,refusals).all();
        // A private branch can choose both results and authored refusals.
        returned.extend(condition.iter().cloned());refusals.extend(condition);
        let mut other=env.clone();statements(bound,then_body,env,reads,returned,refusals);statements(bound,else_body,&mut other,reads,returned,refusals);
        for (n,f) in other{let old=env.remove(&n).unwrap_or_default();env.insert(n,Flow::join(old,f));}
    },
    Stmt::For{binding,domain,body}=>{match domain{
        ir::LoopDomain::Page(s)=>{reads.insert(s.table.clone());env.insert(binding.clone(),row(bound,&s.table));},
        ir::LoopDomain::DerivedArray{value:e,..}=>{let f=value(bound,e,env,reads,returned,refusals);env.insert(binding.clone(),f);},_=>{},
    }statements(bound,body,env,reads,returned,refusals);},_=>{},
}}}
pub(super) fn notes(bound:&Bound)->Vec<Diagnostic>{
    let flows=bound.programs.iter().map(|bp|{let(mut reads,mut returned,mut refusals)=(BTreeSet::new(),Sources::new(),Sources::new());statements(bound,&bp.program.body,&mut BTreeMap::new(),&mut reads,&mut returned,&mut refusals);(bp,reads,returned,refusals)}).collect::<Vec<_>>();
    let mut hidden:BTreeMap<(String,String),BTreeSet<String>>=BTreeMap::new();
    for (bp,reads,returned,_) in &flows{if bp.program.kind!=ir::ProgramKind::Query{continue;}
        for table in reads{if let Some(t)=bound.schema.tables.get(table){for c in t.columns.keys().filter(|c|c.as_str()!="id"){
            if !returned.contains(&(table.clone(),c.clone())){hidden.entry((table.clone(),c.clone())).or_default().insert(bp.program.name.clone());}
        }}}
    }
    let mut grouped=BTreeMap::<String,Vec<(Site,String)>>::new();
    for (bp,_,returned,refusals) in flows{
        for (kind,origins) in [("return/write result",returned),("refusal/branch",refusals)]{
            let mut groups:BTreeMap<String,Vec<String>>=BTreeMap::new();
            for (table,c) in origins{
                let t=&bound.schema.tables[&table];
                let projected=hidden.get(&(table.clone(),c.clone()));
                let ruled=t.column_reads.contains_key(&c)||t.written_by.get(&c).is_some_and(|g|!g.audience);
                if projected.is_none()&&!ruled{continue;}
                // A query's own narrowed result is not an alternate write observer.
                if bp.program.kind==ir::ProgramKind::Query&&kind=="return/write result"&&projected.is_none(){continue;}
                let reason=projected.map(|qs|format!("omitted by {}",qs.iter().cloned().collect::<Vec<_>>().join(", "))).unwrap_or_else(||"column-ruled".into());
                groups.entry(table).or_default().push(format!("{c} ({reason})"));
            }
            for (table,columns) in groups{grouped.entry(table).or_default().push((bp.site.clone(),format!("{} at {}: {kind} observes {}",bp.program.name,bp.site,columns.join(", "))));}
        }
    }
    grouped.into_iter().map(|(table,mut paths)|{
        paths.sort_by_key(|(site,_)|(site.file.clone(),site.line,site.col));
        Diagnostic::new(&paths[0].0,"N_COLUMN_RESULT_EXPOSURE",format!("{table}: {}; row audience: {}",paths.iter().map(|(_,text)|text.as_str()).collect::<Vec<_>>().join("; "),bound.schema.tables[&table].rules.read.quarry()),"confirm each operation's result/refusal audience from the spec; a query projection alone is not privacy. Use column read rules and independent intent; run snapback4 test").guide("security")
    }).collect()
}

//! Deterministic role populations validated by the ordinary seed boundary.
// @ref LLP 3000.036.004#132-generated-initial-worlds-and-password-only-test — generated initialization is explicit.
use super::*;
/// No network, credentials, development doors, durable store or scratch files.
fn proposals(bound:&Bound,out:&mut Campaign)->Result<Engine,String>{
    if !out.reserve(1){return Err("generated fixture world not reserved; remaining initialization uncovered".into());}
    let mut people=Vec::new();
    for (table,_) in bound.schema.visible_tables(){
        let role_columns=super::super::privilege::role_columns(bound,table);
        for column in role_columns{
            {
                for role in super::super::privilege::role_values(bound,table,&column) {for n in 0..2 {people.push((table.clone(),column.clone(),role.clone(),format!("account:security-{table}-{role}-{n}")));}}
            }
        }
    }
    for seat in histories::viewers(bound).into_iter().filter(|p|p.starts_with("service:")&&p!="service:security") {for n in 0..2{people.push((String::new(),String::new(),String::new(),format!("account:security-{}-{n}",seat.replace(':',"-"))));}}
    if people.is_empty(){for n in 0..2{people.push((String::new(),String::new(),String::new(),format!("account:security-owner-{n}")));}}
    if people.len()>64{people.truncate(64);out.unsupported.insert("generated roster capped at 64 principals; additional roles remain uncovered".into());}
    let mut grant_tables=BTreeSet::new();
    fn grants(rule:&RuleExpr,out:&mut BTreeSet<String>){match rule{
        RuleExpr::Exists{table,key,equalities,..} if key.iter().chain(equalities.iter().map(|(_,v)|v)).any(|v|matches!(v,RuleTerm::Viewer))=>{out.insert(table.clone());},
        RuleExpr::And(xs)|RuleExpr::Or(xs)=>for r in xs{grants(r,out)},RuleExpr::Not(r)=>grants(r,out),_=>{}
    }}
    for t in bound.schema.tables.values(){for rule in std::iter::once(&t.rules.read).chain(t.column_reads.values()){grants(rule,&mut grant_tables);}}
    let counts=bound.schema.visible_tables().filter(|(table,_)|bound.schema.maintain_for(table).is_none()).map(|(table,t)|{
        let own=people.iter().filter(|(roster,_,_,_)|roster==table).count();(table.clone(),if own>0{own}else if grant_tables.contains(table)||std::iter::once(&t.rules.read).chain(t.column_reads.values()).any(|rule|rule.any_term(&|term|matches!(term,RuleTerm::Field(c) if t.columns.get(c).is_some_and(|k|matches!(k.required(),C::Principal))))){people.len().max(1usize<<t.columns.values().filter(|k|matches!(k.required(),C::Principal)).count().min(3))}else{t.columns.values().filter_map(|k|if let C::Enum{variants}=k.required(){Some(variants.len())}else{None}).max().unwrap_or(2).max(1usize<<t.columns.values().filter(|k|matches!(k.required(),C::Principal)).count().min(3)).clamp(2,8)})
    }).collect::<BTreeMap<_,_>>();
    let mut rows=BTreeMap::new();
    for (table,t) in bound.schema.visible_tables(){
        if !counts.contains_key(table){continue;}
        let own=people.iter().filter(|(roster,_,_,_)|roster==table).collect::<Vec<_>>();
        if t.columns.values().filter(|k|matches!(k.required(),C::Principal)).count()>3 {out.unsupported.insert(format!("generated fixture {table}: full Cartesian combinations above three principal columns remain uncovered"));}
        let mut population=Vec::new();
        for n in 0..counts[table]{
            let person=if own.is_empty(){&people[n%people.len()]}else{own[n]};
            let mut fields=BTreeMap::from([("id".into(),Value::Id(format!("security-{table}-{n}")))]);
            let mut principal=0;
            for (column,kind) in &t.columns {
                if column=="id"||t.engine_field(column)||t.recorded.contains_key(column)||t.maintained.contains_key(column){continue;}
                let mut value=if kind.is_optional()&&n%2==0&&!(person.0==*table&&person.1==*column){Value::Null}else{match sample(kind.required(),4+n){Some(value)=>value,None=>{out.unsupported.insert(format!("generated fixture {table}.{column}: unsupported typed sample"));continue;}}};
                if value==Value::Null&&kind.is_optional(){fields.insert(column.clone(),value);continue;}
                match kind.required(){
                    C::Principal=>{
                        let linked=!own.is_empty()||grant_tables.contains(table)||t.constraints.iter().any(|constraint|matches!(constraint,Constraint::FinalExistsOnInsert{key,..} if key.iter().any(|term|matches!(term,RuleTerm::Field(c) if c==column))));
                        value=Value::Id(if linked{if principal==0{person.3.clone()}else{people[(n+principal)%people.len()].3.clone()}}else{if (n>>principal.min(5))&1==0{VIEWER}else{OTHER}.into()});principal+=1;
                    },
                    C::Ref{table:target}=>{value=Value::Id(format!("security-{target}-{}",n%counts.get(target).copied().unwrap_or(1)));},
                    C::Enum{..}|C::Text{..} if person.0==*table&&person.1==*column=>value=Value::String(person.2.clone()),
                    C::Text{max}=>{let minimum=t.constraints.iter().filter_map(|c|if let Constraint::Text{field,min,..}=c{(field==column).then_some(*min as usize)}else{None}).max().unwrap_or(1);let suffix=format!("sample{n}");value=Value::String(format!("{suffix}{}","x".repeat(minimum.saturating_sub(suffix.len()))).chars().take(*max as usize).collect());},
                    C::Time=>value=Value::Int(NOW+if t.expire.as_deref()==Some(column){86_400_000}else{-1000}),
                    _=>{},
                }
                fields.insert(column.clone(),value);
            }
            population.push(Value::Row(fields.into()));
        }
        rows.insert(table.clone(),population);
    }
    // Batch validation preserves final-exists, parent ordering and maintains.
    if let Ok(engine)=engine_with(bound,&rows,Vec::new()){return Ok(engine);}
    if !out.reserve(1){return Err("generated fallback world not reserved; initialization uncovered".into());}
    let mut engine=engine_with(bound,&BTreeMap::new(),Vec::new())?;
    let mut pending=rows.into_iter().flat_map(|(table,rows)|rows.into_iter().map(move|row|(table.clone(),row))).collect::<Vec<_>>();
    let mut reasons=BTreeMap::new();
    for _ in 0..=bound.schema.tables.len(){
        let before=pending.len();let mut retry=Vec::new();
        for (table,mut row) in pending {
            if !out.reserve(1){validate_fixture(bound,&mut engine)?;return Ok(engine);}
            let attempt=(||{
                for (column,kind) in &bound.schema.tables[&table].columns {if let Ok(value)=row.field(column){let value=hydrate(&mut engine,kind,value)?;if let Value::Row(fields)=&mut row{fields.insert(column.clone(),value);}}}
                engine.seed_at([(table.clone(),row.clone())],NOW).map_err(|e|e.to_string())?;Ok::<_,String>(())
            })();
            if let Err(why)=attempt{reasons.insert(table.clone(),why);retry.push((table,row));}
        }
        pending=retry;if pending.len()==before{break;}
    }
    for (table,why) in reasons{if pending.iter().any(|(name,_)|name==&table){out.unsupported.insert(format!("generated fixture {table}: some related rows declined by ordinary validation: {why}"));}}
    validate_fixture(bound,&mut engine)?;
    Ok(engine)
}

// @ref LLP 3000.036.004#137-wave-19-correction-admissible-starts-and-persistent-refutations — creator guards/copies are part of generated initialization.
pub fn fixture(bound:&Bound,out:&mut Campaign)->Result<Engine,String>{
    let proposed=proposals(bound,out)?;
    let rows=readback(&proposed)?;
    let actors=histories::actors(bound,&rows);
    // A principal key and a field named role are insufficient: payload tables
    // must execute their creators even when they happen to have that shape.
    fn authority_roster(bound:&Bound,name:&str)->bool{
        let columns=super::super::privilege::role_columns(bound,name);
        fn used(bound:&Bound,rule:&RuleExpr,name:&str,columns:&BTreeSet<String>)->bool{match rule{
            RuleExpr::Exists{table,index,key,equalities,..} if table==name&&key.iter().chain(equalities.iter().map(|(_,v)|v)).any(|v|matches!(v,RuleTerm::Viewer))=>super::super::privilege::probe_pairs(bound,table,index,key,equalities).iter().any(|(c,v)|columns.contains(c)&&matches!(v,RuleTerm::Literal(Value::String(_)))),
            RuleExpr::And(xs)|RuleExpr::Or(xs)=>xs.iter().any(|r|used(bound,r,name,columns)),RuleExpr::Not(r)=>used(bound,r,name,columns),_=>false,
        }}
        !columns.is_empty()&&bound.schema.tables.values().any(|t|[&t.rules.read,&t.rules.insert,&t.rules.update,&t.rules.delete].into_iter().chain(t.column_reads.values()).any(|r|used(bound,r,name,&columns)))
    }
    let rosters=bound.schema.visible_tables().filter(|(name,_)|authority_roster(bound,name)).map(|(name,_)|name.clone()).collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
    let mut creators=bound.programs.iter().filter(|p|p.program.kind==ProgramKind::Mutation&&!p.program.native&&!bound.schema.operations.get(&p.program.name).is_some_and(|f|f.ephemeral)&&ir::write_tables(&p.program).iter().any(|(_,kind)|matches!(*kind,"insert"|"upsert"))).collect::<Vec<_>>();
    creators.sort_by_key(|p|ir::write_tables(&p.program).iter().any(|(_,kind)|matches!(*kind,"update"|"upsert"|"delete")));
    let created=creators.iter().flat_map(|p|ir::write_tables(&p.program)).filter(|(_,kind)|matches!(*kind,"insert"|"upsert")).map(|(t,_)|t).collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
    let mut engine=engine_on_store(bound,&BTreeMap::new(),Vec::new(),proposed.store().empty_with_asset_ledger().map_err(|e|e.to_string())?)?;
    let mut pending=rows.iter().filter(|(t,_)|rosters.contains(*t)||!created.contains(*t)).flat_map(|(t,rs)|rs.iter().map(move|r|(t.clone(),r.clone()))).collect::<Vec<_>>();
    // Bootstrap proposals require an actor admitted by the insert rule in the
    // previous world. Never let a proposed role authorize its own insertion.
    for _ in 0..=bound.schema.tables.len(){
        let before=pending.len();let mut retry=Vec::new();
        for (table,row) in pending{
            if !out.reserve(1){out.unsupported.insert("generated initialization work exhausted; remaining populations uncovered".into());validate_fixture(bound,&mut engine)?;return Ok(engine);}
            let seeded=clean_row(bound,&table,&row);
            let mut accepted=None;
            for actor in &actors{
                if !out.reserve(1){break;}
                // This only orders ordinary replay work: a definitely denied
                // pre-insert gate cannot be rescued by copying the entire
                // ledger. Unknown and defaults still go through the engine.
                if matches!(engine.fixture_policy(&bound.schema.tables[&table].rules.insert,actor,None,&seeded,NOW),Ok(rules::Verdict::Denied)){continue;}
                let mut candidate=engine.fork_fixture().map_err(|e|e.to_string())?;
                if matches!(candidate.insert_fixture(&table,seeded.clone(),actor,NOW),Ok(r) if matches!(r.state,snapback4_core::WriteState::Sent{..})){accepted=Some(candidate);break;}
            }
            if let Some(candidate)=accepted{engine=candidate;}else{retry.push((table,row));}
        }
        pending=retry;if pending.len()==before{break;}
    }
    for (table,_) in pending{out.unsupported.insert(format!("generated fixture {table}: no admitted insert/bootstrap; population uncovered"));}
    // Try principals in the admitted authority rosters before outsider probes.
    // This only orders candidates: every creator and recipient guard still
    // executes normally, and outsider actors remain in the finite campaign.
    // Avoid spending the short check budget hydrating media for absent roles.
    let mut creator_actors=actors.clone();
    let admitted=readback(&engine)?;
    let roster_principals=rosters.iter().flat_map(|name|admitted.get(name).into_iter().flatten().flat_map(|row|{
        bound.schema.tables[name].columns.iter().filter_map(move |(column,kind)|{
            if matches!(kind.required(),C::Principal){match row.field(column){Ok(Value::Id(p))=>Some(p.clone()),_=>None}}else{None}
        })
    })).collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
    creator_actors.sort_by_key(|actor|!roster_principals.contains(actor));
    // Authored insertion bodies preserve requires, immutable copies, defaults,
    // role checks on principal arguments and multi-table creation invariants.
    let mut attempts=0usize;let mut root_observed=false;
    for _ in 0..=bound.schema.tables.len().min(12){
        let before=readback(&engine)?;
        for bp in &creators{
            let p=&bp.program;let writes=ir::write_tables(p);
            // Preserve a pre-transition root population. Later derived creators
            // can otherwise consume every pending lifecycle row during setup.
            if !root_observed&&writes.iter().any(|(_,kind)|matches!(*kind,"update"|"upsert"|"delete")){
                root_observed=true;
                if out.generated_fixture&&out.work_remaining.is_none()&&validate_fixture(bound,&mut engine).is_ok(){
                    let first=out.violations.len();histories::lifecycle_observers(bound,&engine,out);
                    for witness in &mut out.violations[first..]{if witness.reachability==Reachability::AuthoredFixtureTrace{witness.reachability=Reachability::GeneratedFixtureTrace;witness.scope="actual authored observation from a validated generated root fixture before derived creator transitions; initialization is not claimed application-reachable".into();}}
                }
            }
            let implicit=stability::implicit(bound,p);
            if writes.iter().all(|(t,_)|rosters.contains(t)){continue;}
            let current=readback(&engine)?;
            let targets=writes.iter().filter(|(_,kind)|matches!(*kind,"insert"|"upsert")).map(|(t,_)|t).collect::<Vec<_>>();
            if targets.iter().all(|t|current.get(*t).map_or(0,Vec::len)>=2){continue;}
            let cases=histories::fixture_cases(bound,p,&current,&creator_actors,out);
            'cases:for args in cases.into_iter().take(16){for actor in &creator_actors{
                if attempts>=2048||!out.reserve(1){out.unsupported.insert("generated authored initialization capped at 2048 calls; remaining creators uncovered".into());validate_fixture(bound,&mut engine)?;return Ok(engine);}
                attempts+=1;
                if targets.len()==1{
                    let gate=&bound.schema.tables[targets[0]].rules.insert;
                    let stable=!gate.any_term(&|term|!matches!(term,RuleTerm::Viewer|RuleTerm::Literal(_)))
                        &&kernel::dependencies(gate).iter().all(|dep|!implicit.contains(dep)&&!writes.iter().any(|(t,_)|t==dep));
                        &&kernel::dependencies(gate).iter().all(|dep|!implicit.contains(dep)&&!writes.iter().any(|(t,_)|t==dep));
                    if stable&&matches!(engine.fixture_policy(gate,actor,None,&Value::Null,NOW),Ok(rules::Verdict::Denied)){continue;}
                }
                let mut candidate=engine.fork_fixture().map_err(|e|e.to_string())?;
                let args=match materialize_arguments(&mut candidate,&p.args,&args,actor){Ok(a)=>a,Err(_)=>continue};
                let result=candidate.mutate(&p.name,None,Context::new(actor,args).at(NOW));
                if matches!(result,Ok(r) if matches!(r.state,snapback4_core::WriteState::Sent{..})) {
                    let after=readback(&candidate)?;
                    if targets.iter().any(|t|after.get(*t).map_or(0,Vec::len)>current.get(*t).map_or(0,Vec::len)) {engine=candidate;}
                    let after=readback(&engine)?;
                    if targets.iter().all(|t|after.get(*t).map_or(0,Vec::len)>=2){break 'cases;}
                }
            }}
        }
        if readback(&engine)?==before{break;}
    }
    for table in created.difference(&rosters){if engine.store().rows(table).map_err(|e|e.to_string())?.is_empty(){out.unsupported.insert(format!("generated fixture {table}: authored creator did not populate this table"));}}
    validate_fixture(bound,&mut engine)?;Ok(engine)
}
fn clean_row(bound:&Bound,table:&str,row:&Value)->Value{
    let t=&bound.schema.tables[table];
    match row{Value::Row(fields)=>Value::Row(fields.iter().filter(|(c,_)|!t.engine_field(c)&&!t.recorded.contains_key(*c)&&!t.maintained.contains_key(*c)).map(|(c,v)|(c.clone(),v.clone())).collect()),_=>row.clone()}
}
pub fn generated_campaign(bound:&Bound,campaign:&mut Campaign,matrix:bool){
    for (name,_) in bound.schema.visible_tables().filter(|(_,t)|t.ephemeral.is_some()){campaign.unsupported.insert(format!("ephemeral {name}: generated memory populations and ephemeral mutation histories remain uncovered; durable campaigns use isolated hub copies"));}
    campaign.history_limit=64;campaign.generated_fixture=false;
    if !campaign.reserve(1){return;}
    match engine_with(bound,&BTreeMap::new(),Vec::new()){
        Ok(empty)=>fixture_observers(bound,&empty,campaign),
        Err(why)=>{campaign.unsupported.insert(format!("empty initial campaign unavailable: {why}"));}
    }
    campaign.history_limit=448;campaign.generated_fixture=true;
    match generated_fixture(bound,campaign){
        Ok(fixture)=>if matrix{operations(bound,&fixture,campaign)}else{fixture_observers(bound,&fixture,campaign)},
        Err(why)=>{campaign.unsupported.insert(format!("generated fixture campaign unavailable: {why}"));}
    }
    campaign.history_limit=0;campaign.generated_fixture=false;
}
/// Exercise every authored query/mutation with cross-principal candidates.
/// This is conformance exploration, not a guessed spec oracle: only declared
/// policies and replayed violations can fail security acceptance.
pub fn fixture_observers(bound:&Bound,fixture:&Engine,campaign:&mut Campaign){
    let first=campaign.violations.len();
    column_reads::direct_fixture(bound,fixture,campaign);
    histories::initial_observers(bound,fixture,campaign);
    histories::lifecycle_observers(bound,fixture,campaign);
    column_reads::fixture(bound,fixture,campaign);
    if !campaign.generated_fixture {trusted_reads(bound,fixture,campaign);}
    histories::run(bound,fixture,campaign);
    if campaign.generated_fixture {for witness in &mut campaign.violations[first..] {
        if witness.reachability==Reachability::AuthoredFixtureTrace {witness.reachability=Reachability::GeneratedFixtureTrace;witness.scope="actual authored observation from a validated generated initial fixture; fixture initialization is not claimed application-reachable".into();}
    }}
}

// @ref LLP 3000.036.004#143-concrete-role-refutations-and-coupled-worlds — failed implication only orders a concrete, authored replay.
pub(super) fn direct_refutations(bound:&Bound,campaign:&mut Campaign){
    let first=campaign.violations.len();
    campaign.generated_fixture=true;
    match generated_fixture(bound,campaign){
        Ok(fixture)=>{
            column_reads::direct_fixture(bound,&fixture,campaign);
            histories::initial_observers(bound,&fixture,campaign);
        },
        Err(why)=>{campaign.unsupported.insert(format!("direct read witness unavailable: {why}"));}
    }
    for v in &mut campaign.violations[first..]{
        if v.reachability==Reachability::AuthoredFixtureTrace{
            v.reachability=Reachability::GeneratedFixtureTrace;
            v.scope="actual authored observation from an insert-admitted generated fixture; initialization is not claimed reachable from an empty application".into();
        }
    }
    campaign.generated_fixture=false;
}
pub fn operations(bound:&Bound,fixture:&Engine,campaign:&mut Campaign){
    let first=campaign.violations.len();
    fixture_observers(bound,fixture,campaign);
    assets::run(bound,fixture,campaign);
    let fixtures=match readback(fixture){Ok(r)=>r,Err(e)=>{campaign.unsupported.insert(e);return;}};
    let has_fixture=fixtures.values().any(|r|!r.is_empty());
    if fixtures.values().map(Vec::len).sum::<usize>()>1000{campaign.unsupported.insert("operation fixture matrix exceeds 1000 rows; provide a focused security fixture".into());return;}
    let mut viewers=histories::viewers(bound);
    } else {
        format!("review {subject}: no checked rewrite; keep the query and handle partial data (check --verbose)")
    };
    let admitted = ["for callers `", "except for callers `"].into_iter().find_map(|needle| {
        note.message.split_once(needle)?.1.split_once("` admits").map(|(rule, _)| rule)
    });
    let mut who = match admitted {
        Some(rule) => format!("audience: `{rule}` is proved complete; other callers may be capped"),
        None if note.code == "N_CONDITIONAL_COMPLETE" => "audience: pinned parent readers are proved complete; other callers may be capped".into(),
        None => "audience: completeness is not proved for every caller; runtime complete may still be true".into(),
    };
    if let Some(scan) = note.message.split_once(" over ").and_then(|(_, tail)| tail.split_once(" is ").map(|(scan, _)| scan)) {
        who.push_str(&format!(" (scan {scan})"));
    }
    Some([action, "impact: fine for a screen showing returned rows; proving absence or all matches needs complete: true; keep partial data visible".into(), who])
}

/// `check --emit-lean <file.q>`: one file, checked, as the Lean model's
/// schema, helpers and programs (`snapback4_lang::emit::lean`).
// @ref LLP 3000.035#52-stage-2-a-small-lean-core — the emitter's command-line face; the harness calls the library directly
fn emit_lean(file: &str) -> i32 {
    let source = match std::fs::read_to_string(file) {
        Ok(source) => source,
        Err(error) => { eprintln!("cannot read {file}: {error}"); return 2; }
    };
    let name = Path::new(file).file_name().and_then(|n| n.to_str()).unwrap_or(file).to_owned();
    match snapback4_lang::emit::lean::lean(&[(name, source)]) {
        Ok(module) => { println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&module.to_json()).unwrap()); 0 }
        Err(snapback4_lang::emit::lean::LeanError::Diagnostics(problems)) => {
            for problem in problems { eprintln!("{problem}"); }
            1
        }
        Err(snapback4_lang::emit::lean::LeanError::Unsupported(u)) => {
            eprintln!("outside the Lean model's fragment: {u}");
            1
        }
    }
}

pub fn check(options: &Options) -> i32 {
    if options.flags.contains_key("audit") { return security::audit(options); }
    if options.flags.contains_key("store") && options.flags.contains_key("release") {
        return releases::check_release(options);
    }

    if let Some(file) = options.flags.get("emit-lean") {
        return emit_lean(file);
    }
    let project = project_or_exit();
    let started = Instant::now();
    package_versions::warn(&project);
    upgrade_history::report(&project, options.json);
    if options.flags.contains_key("fix") {
        if let Err(code) = fix::checked(fix::compile(&project)) { return code; }
    }
    let compiled_sources = match project.sources() {
        Ok(sources) => sources,
        Err(error) => { eprintln!("cannot read snapback/: {error}"); return 2; }
    };
    let mut bound = snapback4_lang::compile(&compiled_sources);
    let reviewable_notes = bound.notes.iter().map(note_reviews::fingerprint).collect();
    for warning in saved_fixture_drift::warnings(&project) {
        if warning.drift { eprintln!("check: WARNING: saved fixture drift: {}", warning.message); }
        else { eprintln!("check: info: {}", warning.message); }
    }
    if options.flags.contains_key("fix") && bound.diagnostics.is_empty() {
        if let Err(error) = fix_fixtures::run(&project, &bound, options) { failed_check(&bound, options.json, "E_INPUT", format!("check --fix: {error}")); return 2; }
    }

    if let Some(hint) = project.saved_copy_hint() { if options.json { eprintln!("check: {hint}"); } else { println!("check: {hint}"); } }
    if let Some(error) = crate::exact_device::inspect(&project.root, &bound.schema).into_iter().find_map(Result::err) {
        if options.json { println!("{}", json!({"ok": false, "denied": {"code": "E_DEVICE_VERSION", "message": error}, "notes": bound.notes, "newNotes": bound.notes, "acknowledgedNotes": []})); }
        else { eprintln!("{error}"); }
        return 1;
    }
    if !bound.diagnostics.is_empty() {
        check_surface::report(&project, &bound, options.json);
        report_diagnostics(&bound, options.json, true, options.flags.contains_key("verbose"));
        if !options.json { print_prediction(&bound, options.flags.contains_key("verbose")); }
        return 1;
    }
    let security = security::report(&project, &bound, &compiled_sources, options);
    // @ref LLP 3000.007#18.3 — check judges adoption against the dev store's active generation and rows, read-only
    match adoption::diagnostics(&project, &bound.schema, options.flags.get("store"), options.json || options.flags.contains_key("verbose")) {
        Ok((problems, notes)) => { bound.diagnostics.extend(problems); bound.notes.extend(notes); },
        Err(error) => { failed_check(&bound, options.json, "E_STORE", format!("cannot check store adoption: {error}")); return 2; }
    }
    if !bound.diagnostics.is_empty() {
        check_surface::report(&project, &bound, options.json);
        report_diagnostics(&bound, options.json, true, options.flags.contains_key("verbose"));
        if !options.json { print_prediction(&bound, options.flags.contains_key("verbose")); }
        return 1;
    }
    for diagnostic in readiness::notes(&project, &bound, options.flags.get("fixture")) {
        if diagnostic.code == "E_FIXTURE_TIME" { bound.diagnostics.push(diagnostic); }
        else { bound.notes.push(diagnostic); }
    }
    if !bound.diagnostics.is_empty() {
        report_diagnostics(&bound, options.json, true, options.flags.contains_key("verbose"));
        return 1;
    }
    bound.notes.extend(snapback4_lang::bind::residency::change_notes(&bound, &residency::previous(&project)));
    check_surface::report(&project, &bound, options.json);
    if let Err(error) = project.write_generated(&bound) {
        failed_check(&bound, options.json, "E_STORE", format!("cannot write generated types: {error}"));
        return 2;
    }
    if let Err(error) = project.check_server() {
        if options.json { println!("{}", json!({ "ok": false, "problems": [{ "code": if error.starts_with("E_SERVER_TOOLCHAIN") { "E_SERVER_TOOLCHAIN" } else { "E_SERVER_TYPECHECK" }, "message": error, "guide": "actions" }], "notes": bound.notes, "newNotes": bound.notes, "acknowledgedNotes": [] })); }
        else { eprintln!("{error}"); }
        return 1;
    }
    // A native job's module is built here too (LLP 3000.005): the schema's
    // Rust types written, cargo run, the module checked against the jobs.
    let native = match crate::native::build(&project, &bound) {
        Ok(built) => built,
        Err(problem) => {
            if options.json {
                println!("{}", json!({ "ok": false, "problems": [{ "code": problem.code, "message": problem.message, "rewrite": problem.rewrite, "guide": "native" }], "notes": bound.notes, "newNotes": bound.notes, "acknowledgedNotes": [] }));
            } else {
                eprintln!("{problem}\n");
                eprintln!("check: 1 problem");
            }
            return 1;
        }
    };
    check_surface::remember(&project, &bound);
    if let Err(error) = residency::remember(&project, &bound) { failed_check(&bound, options.json, "E_STORE", format!("cannot write residency facts: {error}")); return 2; }
    let acquisition = if options.flags.contains_key("residency") {
        match residency::at_check(&project, &bound, options) {
            Ok(report) => report,
            Err(error) => { failed_check(&bound, options.json, "E_INPUT", format!("residency measurement failed: {error}")); return 1; }
        }
    } else { None };
    // @ref LLP 3000.036.002#132-reviewed-notes — every failed check preserves review evidence, including independent policy refutations.
    let reviewed = if security.refuted() {
        note_reviews::Review { new: bound.notes.clone(), acknowledged: Vec::new() }
    } else { match note_reviews::review(&project, &compiled_sources, &bound.notes, &reviewable_notes, options.flags.contains_key("ack-notes")) {
        Ok(review) => review,
        Err(error) => {
            if options.json { println!("{}", json!({"ok": false, "problems": [{"code": "E_CHECK_NOTES", "message": error}], "notes": bound.notes, "newNotes": bound.notes, "acknowledgedNotes": []})); }
            else { eprintln!("check: E_CHECK_NOTES: {error}"); }
            return 2;
        }
    } };
    let dispositions = match security_reviews::review(&project,&compiled_sources,&security.notes,
        if security.refuted(){None}else{options.flags.get("ack-security").map(|id|(id.as_str(),options.flags.get("reason").map(String::as_str).unwrap_or("")))}) {
        Ok(d)=>d,Err(error)=>{if options.json {println!("{}",json!({"ok":false,"security":&security,"problems":[{"code":"E_SECURITY_NOTES","message":error}]}));}else{eprintln!("check: E_SECURITY_NOTES: {error}");}return 2;}
    };
    let security_failed=security.refuted()||security_reviews::pending(&dispositions);
    let visible_security=security.notes.iter().zip(&dispositions).filter(|(_,d)|!d.acknowledged).map(|(n,_)|n).collect::<Vec<_>>();
    let present = |text: &str| crate::presentation::indexes(&bound.schema, text, options.flags.contains_key("verbose"));
    let details = acquisition.is_none() || options.flags.contains_key("verbose");
    let certificates: Vec<_> = bound.programs.iter().map(|p| crate::scale::analyze_bound(&bound.schema, p)).collect();
    let scale_summary = crate::scale::summary(&certificates);
    let note_count = security.notes.len() + reviewed.new.len() + certificates.iter().map(|certificate| certificate.search.len()).sum::<usize>();
    let field_authority: Vec<_> = bound.schema.visible_tables().flat_map(|(name,table)| table.written_by.iter().map(move |(column,authority)|
        format!("{name}.{column}: written by .{}; visibility: {}", authority.owner, if authority.audience { "readable by audience" } else { "private to owner" }))).collect();
    let row_views = bound.schema.maintains.iter().filter_map(|m| m.row_key.as_ref().map(|k| json!({
        "view": m.target, "source": m.source, "sourceKey": k.source_key, "member": k.table,
        "memberKey": k.member_key, "fanout": k.fanout, "range": row_view_range(&bound.schema, m), "writerRecount": snapback4_core::engine::row_views::WRITER_RECOUNT, "recountChunk": snapback4_core::engine::row_views::RECOUNT_CHUNK
    }))).collect::<Vec<_>>();
    let elapsed = started.elapsed();
    let synced = bound.schema.synced().count();
    let sequences: Vec<_> = bound.schema.visible_tables().flat_map(|(name, table)| table.sequences.iter().map(move |(column, reference)| {
        format!("sequence {name}.{column}: counter per {} row through .{reference}; immutable, provisional while pending", table.columns[reference])
    })).collect();
    if options.json {
        println!("{}", json!({ "ok": !security_failed, "securityReviews": &dispositions, "security": &security, "followingHistory": bound.programs.iter().filter_map(|p| crate::scale::following::certificate(&bound.schema, &p.program)).collect::<Vec<_>>(), "rowViews": row_views, "fieldAuthority": field_authority, "sequences": sequences, "scaleSummary": scale_summary, "search": certificates.iter().flat_map(|certificate| &certificate.search).collect::<Vec<_>>(), "plans": if options.flags.contains_key("cost") { Some(bound.programs.iter().map(|p| (&p.program.name, p.selections())).collect::<BTreeMap<_, _>>()) } else { None }, "scale": if options.flags.contains_key("cost") { Some(&certificates) } else { None }, "tables": bound.schema.visible_tables().filter(|(name, _)| bound.schema.maintain_for(name).is_none()).count(), "views": bound.schema.visible_tables().filter(|(name, _)| bound.schema.maintain_for(name).is_some()).count(), "synced": synced, "operations": bound.programs.len(), "heldQueries": bound.schema.operations.iter().filter(|(_, fact)| fact.held).map(|(name, _)| name).collect::<Vec<_>>(), "notes": bound.notes, "newNotes": reviewed.new, "acknowledgedNotes": reviewed.acknowledged, "predictionSummary": snapback4_lang::bind::residency::prediction_summary(&bound), "starterLeftovers": init::starter_leftovers_json(&project.root), "acquisition": acquisition, "residency": if options.flags.contains_key("residency") { Some(residency::facts(&bound)) } else { None }, "native": native.as_ref().map(|b| json!({ "module": b.path, "bytes": b.bytes, "jobs": b.jobs, "ms": b.ms })), "ms": elapsed.as_millis() }));
    } else {
        println!("check: {} — {} ({synced} synced), {} operations, {}{}, {:.1} ms{}", if security_failed { "failed" } else { "ok" }, table_counts(&bound.schema), bound.programs.len(), if security.refuted() { "security invariant refuted" } else if security_failed { "security review required" } else { "compiled" }, if note_count == 0 { String::new() } else { format!(", {} note{}", note_count, if note_count == 1 { "" } else { "s" }) }, elapsed.as_secs_f64() * 1000.0, match &native { Some(b) => format!("; native: {} → {} ({} B, {} ms)", b.jobs.join(", "), b.path.display(), b.bytes, b.ms), None => String::new() });
        if !reviewed.acknowledged.is_empty() { println!("{} reviewed notes (check --verbose to inspect); source edits require review again", reviewed.acknowledged.len()); }
        if options.flags.contains_key("verbose") {
            for line in &sequences { println!("  {line}"); }
            for (name, _) in bound.schema.visible_tables().filter(|(_, t)| t.ephemeral.is_some()) {

//! Role authority is compared by effective gates, never by names like 'admin'.
// @ref LLP 3000.036.004#123-actionable-authority-advice — advisory grant-edge analysis, not a security proof or implicit exemption.
use super::*;
pub(super) fn probe_pairs(bound:&Bound,table:&str,index:&str,key:&[RuleTerm],equalities:&[(String,RuleTerm)])->Vec<(String,RuleTerm)>{
    let mut pairs=equalities.to_vec();
    if let Some(idx)=bound.schema.table(table).and_then(|t|t.index(index)){for (component,term) in idx.components.iter().zip(key){if let Some(column)=component.column(){pairs.push((column.into(),term.clone()));}}}
    pairs
}
pub(super) fn global_principal(bound:&Bound,table:&str)->Option<String>{
    let t=bound.schema.table(table)?;
    t.indexes.values().find_map(|index|{
        if !index.unique||index.components.len()!=1{return None;}
        let column=index.components[0].column()?;
        matches!(t.columns.get(column),Some(snapback4_core::schema::ColumnType::Principal)).then(||column.to_string())
    })
}
pub(super) fn membership_probe(bound:&Bound,rule:&RuleExpr,roster:&str)->bool{
    let RuleExpr::Exists{table,index,key,equalities,..}=rule else{return false;};
    if table!=roster{return false;}
    let Some(principal)=global_principal(bound,table)else{return false;};
    let pairs=probe_pairs(bound,table,index,key,equalities);
    pairs.len()==1&&pairs[0].0==principal&&pairs[0].1==RuleTerm::Viewer
}
// @ref LLP 3000.015#1 — ownership is required for every supplied owned field;
// only an exclusively owned patch bypasses an unnamed row update gate.
fn write_admission(table:&snapback4_core::schema::Table,op:ast::WriteOp,fields:&[ast::ObjectField])->RuleExpr{
    let touched=fields.iter().filter(|f|!f.spread&&f.name!="id").map(|f|f.name.as_str()).collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
    let owned_only=!touched.is_empty()&&!fields.iter().any(|f|f.spread)&&touched.iter().all(|f|table.written_by.contains_key(*f));
    let gate=match op{
        ast::WriteOp::Insert=>table.rules.insert.clone(),
        ast::WriteOp::Update if owned_only&&!table.update_transition=>RuleExpr::Allow,
        ast::WriteOp::Update=>table.update_rule_judged().into_owned(),
        _=>RuleExpr::Deny,
    };
    let mut owners=table.written_by.iter().filter(|(field,authority)|touched.contains(field.as_str())||op==ast::WriteOp::Update&&!authority.audience&&table.rules.update.needs_field_value(field,&table.columns[*field])).map(|(_,authority)|RuleExpr::Eq(if op==ast::WriteOp::Insert{RuleTerm::Field(authority.owner.clone())}else{RuleTerm::OldField(authority.owner.clone())},RuleTerm::Viewer)).collect::<Vec<_>>();
    owners.push(RuleExpr::Or(gate.disjuncts().iter().filter(|r|r.service_grant().is_none()).map(|r|(*r).clone()).collect()));
    RuleExpr::And(owners)
}
pub(super) fn membership_grant_risk(bound:&Bound,roster:&str,operation:&str,requirements:&[RuleExpr],op:ast::WriteOp,fields:&[ast::ObjectField])->bool{
    if op==ast::WriteOp::Upsert{return membership_grant_risk(bound,roster,operation,requirements,ast::WriteOp::Insert,fields)||membership_grant_risk(bound,roster,operation,requirements,ast::WriteOp::Update,fields);}
    fn honors(bound:&Bound,rule:&RuleExpr,roster:&str)->bool{match rule{
        RuleExpr::And(xs)|RuleExpr::Or(xs)=>xs.iter().any(|r|honors(bound,r,roster)),
        r=>membership_probe(bound,r,roster),
    }}
    if global_principal(bound,roster).is_none()||!bound.schema.tables.values().any(|t|super::columns::rules(t).any(|r|honors(bound,r,roster))){return false;}
    let table=&bound.schema.tables[roster];
    let admission=RuleExpr::And(std::iter::once(write_admission(table,op,fields)).chain(requirements.iter().cloned()).collect());
    if op==ast::WriteOp::Update&&global_principal(bound,roster).is_some_and(|column|kernel::implies(&admission,&RuleExpr::Eq(RuleTerm::OldField(column.clone()),RuleTerm::Field(column)))==Ok(true)){return false;}
    let ordinary=substitute(bound,&admission,"$no-roster","$membership",None,None);
    bound.invariants.iter().filter(|i|i.table==roster&&i.column.is_none()&&(i.operation.as_deref()==Some(operation)||i.operation.is_none()&&(i.target=="write"||i.target==if op==ast::WriteOp::Insert{"insert"}else{"update"}))).filter_map(|i|i.policy.as_ref()).any(|p|super::operation::safe(p)&&kernel::implies(&ordinary,p)==Ok(false))
}
fn substitute(bound:&Bound,rule:&RuleExpr,roster:&str,column:&str,role:Option<&str>,target:Option<&str>)->RuleExpr{
    let known=|t:&RuleTerm|match t{RuleTerm::Field(c)|RuleTerm::NextField(c) if c==column=>target.map(|s|snapback4_core::Value::String(s.into())),RuleTerm::Literal(v)=>Some(v.clone()),_=>None};
    match rule{
        RuleExpr::Exists{table,key,index,equalities,..} if table==roster&&key.iter().chain(equalities.iter().map(|(_,t)|t)).any(|k|matches!(k,RuleTerm::Viewer))=>{
            let pairs=probe_pairs(bound,table,index,key,equalities);
            let requested=pairs.iter().find(|(c,_)|c==column).and_then(|(_,t)|if let RuleTerm::Literal(snapback4_core::Value::String(s))=t{Some(s.as_str())}else{None});
            if requested.is_none(){rule.clone()}else if requested==role{
                if pairs.iter().all(|(c,t)|c==column||matches!(t,RuleTerm::Viewer)){RuleExpr::Allow}else{rule.clone()}
            }else{RuleExpr::Deny}
        },
        RuleExpr::Eq(RuleTerm::Viewer,RuleTerm::Literal(snapback4_core::Value::Id(seat)))|RuleExpr::Eq(RuleTerm::Literal(snapback4_core::Value::Id(seat)),RuleTerm::Viewer) if seat.starts_with("service:")=>RuleExpr::Deny,
        RuleExpr::Eq(a,b)|RuleExpr::Ne(a,b)=>if let (Some(a),Some(b))=(known(a),known(b)){if (a==b)==matches!(rule,RuleExpr::Eq(..)){RuleExpr::Allow}else{RuleExpr::Deny}}else{rule.clone()},
        RuleExpr::And(xs)=>RuleExpr::And(xs.iter().map(|r|substitute(bound,r,roster,column,role,target)).collect()),
        RuleExpr::Or(xs)=>RuleExpr::Or(xs.iter().map(|r|substitute(bound,r,roster,column,role,target)).collect()),
        RuleExpr::Not(r)=>RuleExpr::Not(Box::new(substitute(bound,r,roster,column,role,target))),
        _=>rule.clone(),
    }
}
pub(super) fn risk(bound:&Bound,roster:&str,column:&str,operation:&str,targets:&[String],op:ast::WriteOp,requirements:&[RuleExpr],dynamic:bool,fields:&[ast::ObjectField])->Option<String>{
    if op==ast::WriteOp::Upsert{return risk(bound,roster,column,operation,targets,ast::WriteOp::Insert,requirements,dynamic,fields).or_else(||risk(bound,roster,column,operation,targets,ast::WriteOp::Update,requirements,dynamic,fields));}
    let table=bound.schema.table(roster)?;
    if requirements.iter().any(|r|!r.disjuncts().is_empty()&&r.disjuncts().iter().all(|b|b.service_grant().is_some())){return None;}
    let roles=role_values(bound,roster,column);
    let intents=bound.invariants.iter().filter(|i|i.table==roster&&i.column.as_deref().is_none_or(|c|c==column)&&(i.operation.as_deref()==Some(operation)||i.operation.is_none()&&(i.target=="write"||i.target==if op==ast::WriteOp::Insert{"insert"}else{"update"}))).filter_map(|i|i.policy.as_ref()).collect::<Vec<_>>();
    fn role_guards(bound:&Bound,rule:&RuleExpr,out:&mut Vec<RuleExpr>){match rule{
        RuleExpr::Exists{table,index,key,equalities,..} if key.iter().chain(equalities.iter().map(|(_,v)|v)).any(|k|matches!(k,RuleTerm::Viewer))&&probe_pairs(bound,table,index,key,equalities).iter().any(|(c,v)|role_columns(bound,table).contains(c)&&matches!(v,RuleTerm::Literal(snapback4_core::Value::String(_))))=>out.push(rule.clone()),
        RuleExpr::And(xs)|RuleExpr::Or(xs)=>for r in xs{role_guards(bound,r,out)},_=>{}
    }}
    let admission=RuleExpr::And(std::iter::once(write_admission(table,op,fields)).chain(requirements.iter().cloned()).collect());
    if op==ast::WriteOp::Update&&kernel::implies(&admission,&RuleExpr::Eq(RuleTerm::OldField(column.into()),RuleTerm::Field(column.into())))==Ok(true){return None;}
    let mut guards=Vec::new();role_guards(bound,&admission,&mut guards);
    let independent=kernel::implies(&substitute(bound,&admission,"$no-roster",column,None,None),&RuleExpr::Or(guards))==Ok(true);
    let mut ranked=roles.iter().filter(|r|targets.is_empty()||targets.contains(r)).collect::<Vec<_>>();
    let score=|role:&&String|bound.schema.visible_tables().flat_map(|(_,t)|super::columns::effects(t)).filter(|(_,rule)|kernel::implies(&RuleExpr::Allow,&substitute(bound,rule,roster,column,Some(role.as_str()),None))==Ok(true)).count();
    ranked.sort_by_key(|role|(std::cmp::Reverse(score(role)),role.as_str()));
    for target in ranked{
        for caller in std::iter::once(None).chain(roles.iter().map(|s|Some(s.as_str()))){
            if caller==Some(target.as_str()){continue;}
            let admitted=substitute(bound,&admission,roster,column,caller,Some(target));
            let admits=kernel::implies(&admitted,&RuleExpr::Deny)!=Ok(true);
            if !admits{continue;}
            let violates_intent=intents.iter().any(|p|kernel::implies(&admitted,&substitute(bound,p,roster,column,caller,Some(target)))==Ok(false));
            // Existing independently gated appointers may delegate different
            // roles. Independent intent can restrict a particular target role.
            if independent&&!violates_intent{continue;}
            if violates_intent{return Some(format!("{roster}.{column} assignment to '{target}' is not established by the independent delegation intent for {}",caller.unwrap_or("a caller without a role")));}
            for (name,t) in bound.schema.visible_tables(){for (effect,rule) in super::columns::effects(t){
                let granted=substitute(bound,&rule,roster,column,Some(target),None);let previous=substitute(bound,&rule,roster,column,caller,None);
                if kernel::implies(&RuleExpr::Allow,&granted)!=Ok(true){continue;}
                if !dynamic&&!((matches!(effect.as_str(),"read"|"delete")||effect.ends_with(" read"))||!role_columns(bound,name).is_empty()){continue;}
                if kernel::implies(&granted,&previous)==Ok(false){return Some(format!("{} can confer '{target}', which adds {name}.{effect} authority not held by {}",roster,caller.unwrap_or("a caller without a role")));}
            }}
        }
    }None
}

pub(super) fn role_columns(bound:&Bound,table:&str)->BTreeSet<String>{
    let mut columns=BTreeSet::new();
    if let Some(t)=bound.schema.table(table){for c in ["role","kind"]{if t.columns.contains_key(c){columns.insert(c.into());}}}
    fn collect(bound:&Bound,rule:&RuleExpr,table:&str,columns:&mut BTreeSet<String>){match rule{
        RuleExpr::Exists{table:t,index,key,equalities,..} if t==table&&key.iter().chain(equalities.iter().map(|(_,v)|v)).any(|k|matches!(k,RuleTerm::Viewer))=>for (c,v) in &probe_pairs(bound,t,index,key,equalities){if matches!(v,RuleTerm::Literal(snapback4_core::Value::String(_))){columns.insert(c.clone());}},
        RuleExpr::And(xs)|RuleExpr::Or(xs)=>for r in xs{collect(bound,r,table,columns)},RuleExpr::Not(r)=>collect(bound,r,table,columns),_=>{}
    }}
    let named=columns.clone();let mut observed=BTreeSet::new();
    for t in bound.schema.tables.values(){for r in super::columns::rules(t){collect(bound,r,table,&mut observed);}}
    let global=bound.schema.table(table).is_some_and(|t|t.indexes.values().any(|index|{
        if !index.unique{return false;}
        let Some(parts)=index.components.iter().map(|p|p.column()).collect::<Option<Vec<_>>>()else{return false;};
        let principals=parts.iter().filter(|c|matches!(t.columns.get(**c).map(|k|k.required()),Some(snapback4_core::schema::ColumnType::Principal))).count();
        if principals!=1{return false;}
        parts.iter().all(|c|matches!(t.columns.get(*c).map(|k|k.required()),Some(snapback4_core::schema::ColumnType::Principal))||named.contains(*c))
            ||named.is_empty()&&observed.len()==1&&parts.len()==2&&parts.iter().all(|c|observed.contains(*c)||matches!(t.columns.get(*c).map(|k|k.required()),Some(snapback4_core::schema::ColumnType::Principal)))
    }));
    if global{for t in bound.schema.tables.values(){for r in super::columns::rules(t){collect(bound,r,table,&mut columns);}}}else{columns.clear();}
    columns
}

pub(super) fn role_values(bound:&Bound,roster:&str,column:&str)->Vec<String>{
    let Some(table)=bound.schema.table(roster)else{return Vec::new();};
    let Some(kind)=table.columns.get(column)else{return Vec::new();};
    match kind.required(){snapback4_core::schema::ColumnType::Enum{variants}=>variants.clone(),snapback4_core::schema::ColumnType::Text{..}=>{
        let mut roles=BTreeSet::new();
        fn collect(bound:&Bound,rule:&RuleExpr,roster:&str,column:&str,roles:&mut BTreeSet<String>){match rule{
            RuleExpr::Exists{table,index,key,equalities,..} if table==roster=>for (c,t) in &probe_pairs(bound,table,index,key,equalities){if c==column&&let RuleTerm::Literal(snapback4_core::Value::String(s))=t{roles.insert(s.clone());}},
            RuleExpr::And(xs)|RuleExpr::Or(xs)=>for r in xs{collect(bound,r,roster,column,roles)},RuleExpr::Not(r)=>collect(bound,r,roster,column,roles),_=>{}
        }}
        for t in bound.schema.tables.values(){for r in super::columns::rules(t){collect(bound,r,roster,column,&mut roles);}}roles.into_iter().collect()
    },_=>Vec::new()}
}
//! Narrow stable leading-require reduction for operation-specific authority.
// @ref LLP 3000.036.004#81-exact-conservative-boundary-review-clarification — unknown write sets never establish stability.
use super::*;
use crate::ast::{Stmt,ProgramDecl,ProgramKind,InvariantDecl,RuleDecl};
use super::super::catalog::TableInfo;
pub(super) fn resolve<'a>(catalog:&'a Catalog,decl:&InvariantDecl)->Option<(String,&'a ProgramDecl)>{
    if matches!(decl.target.as_str(),"read"|"insert"|"update"|"delete"|"always"|"write"){return None;}
    let matches=catalog.documents.iter().flat_map(|d|{let module=std::path::Path::new(&d.file).file_stem().unwrap().to_string_lossy();d.programs.iter().map(move|p|(super::super::operation_name(&module,&p.name),p))})
        .filter(|(name,p)|p.kind==ProgramKind::Mutation&&(name==&decl.target||p.name==decl.target)).collect::<Vec<_>>();
    if matches.len()==1 {matches.into_iter().next()}else{None}
}
pub(super) fn safe(rule:&RuleExpr)->bool {match rule{
    RuleExpr::Exists{key,equalities,..}=>key.iter().chain(equalities.iter().map(|(_,t)|t)).all(|t|matches!(t,RuleTerm::Viewer|RuleTerm::Literal(_))),
    RuleExpr::And(xs)|RuleExpr::Or(xs)=>xs.iter().all(safe),
    RuleExpr::Eq(a,b)|RuleExpr::Ne(a,b)=>[a,b].iter().all(|t|matches!(t,RuleTerm::Viewer|RuleTerm::Literal(_))),
    RuleExpr::Allow|RuleExpr::Deny|RuleExpr::Public{..}=>true,_=>false,
}}
pub(super) fn requirements(catalog:&Catalog,info:&TableInfo,p:&ProgramDecl)->Vec<RuleExpr>{
    let mut out=Vec::new();
    for s in p.prelude.iter().chain(&p.body){let Stmt::Require{condition,site,..}=s else{break};
        let decl=RuleDecl{effect:ast::Effect::Read,bindings:Vec::new(),value:condition.clone(),site:site.clone()};
        if let Ok(rule)=super::super::schema::bind_rule(catalog,info,&decl)&&safe(&rule){out.push(rule);}
    }out
}
pub(super) fn prove(bound:&Bound,inv:&Invariant)->Result<bool,String>{
    let p=bound.programs.iter().find(|p|Some(&p.program.name)==inv.operation.as_ref()).ok_or("operation did not bind")?;
    if !safe(inv.policy.as_ref().ok_or("unsupported policy")?){return Err("operation policy needs unsupported target-image, negative-probe or live-reference bindings".into());}
    let writes=snapback4_core::ir::write_tables(&p.program);
    if !writes.iter().any(|(t,_)|t==&inv.table){return Err("operation has no direct write to the named table; implicit effects require a reduction".into());}
    let dependencies=inv.requirements.iter().flat_map(kernel::dependencies).collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
    if writes.iter().any(|(t,_)|dependencies.contains(t)) {return Err("require dependency can be changed by this operation, including its target write".into());}
    if bound.schema.tables.values().any(|t|!t.maintained.is_empty()||!t.sequences.is_empty()||t.on_delete.values().any(|a|a.writes())) || !bound.schema.maintains.is_empty(){return Err("implicit maintain/sequence/referential writes require dependency stability reduction".into());}
    // Source helpers/control flow may hide write sets or viewer changes.
    let json=serde_json::to_value(&p.program).unwrap();
    fn opaque(v:&serde_json::Value)->bool{match v{serde_json::Value::Object(m)=>m.keys().any(|k|matches!(k.as_str(),"For"|"If"|"JobAs"|"JobQuery"|"Emit"))||m.values().any(opaque),serde_json::Value::Array(xs)=>xs.iter().any(opaque),_=>false}}
    if opaque(&json){return Err("operation control flow or opaque effects are outside stable leading-require reduction".into());}
    let admission=RuleExpr::And(inv.requirements.clone());
    // Table-rule gates can only further restrict a dominating stable require;
    // using the require alone overapproximates effective owner-field gates.
    kernel::implies(&admission,inv.policy.as_ref().unwrap())
}
//! Creation is a write even when an edit operation has the stronger guard.
// @ref LLP 3000.036.004#151-every-executed-write — conditional advice never infers creation policy.
use super::*;
pub(super) fn notes(sources:&[(String,String)],bound:&Bound)->Vec<Diagnostic>{
    let documents=sources.iter().map(|(file,text)|crate::parse_document(file,text).0).collect::<Vec<_>>();
    let catalog=Catalog::build(documents.clone(),&mut Vec::new());
    let mut writes=Vec::new();
    for doc in &documents{for p in &doc.programs{if p.kind!=ast::ProgramKind::Mutation{continue;}
        for (write,context) in super::authority_walk::writes(&catalog,p){
            let ast::Expr::Write{op,table,fields,site,..}=write else{continue;};
            let Some(info)=catalog.tables.get(&table)else{continue;};
            let requirements=super::operation::requirements(&catalog,info,&context);
            let t=&bound.schema.tables[&table];
            let gate=if op==ast::WriteOp::Update{t.update_rule_judged().into_owned()}else{t.rules.insert.clone()};
            let admission=RuleExpr::And(requirements.into_iter().chain([gate]).collect());
            writes.push((p.name.clone(),op,table,fields,site,admission));
        }
    }}
    fn necessary(rule:&RuleExpr)->RuleExpr{match rule{
        RuleExpr::And(xs)=>RuleExpr::And(xs.iter().map(necessary).collect()),
        _ if super::operation::safe(rule)=>rule.clone(),_=>RuleExpr::Allow,
    }}
    let mut out=Vec::new();let mut seen=BTreeSet::new();
    for (name,op,table,fields,site,admission) in &writes{
        if !matches!(op,ast::WriteOp::Insert|ast::WriteOp::Upsert){continue;}
        for (editor,edit,other,patch,_,restricted) in &writes{
            if *edit!=ast::WriteOp::Update||other!=table{continue;}
            let restriction=necessary(restricted);
            if kernel::implies(&RuleExpr::Allow,&restriction)==Ok(true)||kernel::implies(admission,&restriction)!=Ok(false){continue;}
            let columns=patch.iter().filter(|f|fields.iter().any(|insert|{
                if insert.name!=f.name{return false;}
                let Some(value)=&insert.value else{return true;};
                let mut value=value.clone();let mut supplied=false;
                super::super::intent_walk::expression(&mut value,&mut |e|if let ast::Expr::Name{name:argument,..}=e{
                    supplied|=documents.iter().flat_map(|d|&d.programs).filter(|p|p.name==*name).any(|p|p.args.iter().any(|a|a.name==*argument));
                });supplied
            })).map(|f|f.name.clone()).collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
            if columns.is_empty()||!seen.insert((name.clone(),table.clone(),columns.clone(),restriction.quarry())){continue;}
            out.push(Diagnostic::new(site,"N_INSERT_WRITE_INTENT",format!("{name}: {table}.{} can be supplied at insert/upsert without the edit restriction of {editor}: {}; creation admission: {}",columns.into_iter().collect::<Vec<_>>().join(","),restriction.quarry(),admission.quarry()),"confirm whether the spec permits different creation authority; otherwise guard every insert/upsert arm too and declare column write only intent, then run snapback4 test").guide("security"));
        }
    }out
}
-- Wash Fold Laundry — Snapback 4 (Quarry) schema, v1.
-- Roles: customer, attendant, driver, owner (roster in `roles`).
-- Operators bootstrap via the service:operator seat; owners manage staff after that.

use identity password

table roles:
  principal: principal
  role: enum('customer', 'attendant', 'driver', 'owner')
  unique principal
  immutable principal
  read <- .principal = viewer or exists roles[viewer, role = 'attendant'] or exists roles[viewer, role = 'owner'] or viewer = 'service:operator'
  insert <- viewer = 'service:operator' or exists roles[viewer, role = 'owner']
  update <- viewer = 'service:operator' or exists roles[viewer, role = 'owner']
  delete <- viewer = 'service:operator' or exists roles[viewer, role = 'owner']
  online only

table driverRoutes:
  driver: principal
  route: text 1..40
  unique driver
  immutable driver
  read <- .driver = viewer or exists roles[viewer, role = 'attendant'] or exists roles[viewer, role = 'owner'] or viewer = 'service:operator'
  insert <- viewer = 'service:operator' or exists roles[viewer, role = 'owner']
  update <- viewer = 'service:operator' or exists roles[viewer, role = 'owner']
  delete <- viewer = 'service:operator' or exists roles[viewer, role = 'owner']
  online only

-- One bag drop-off. priceCents is computed server-side from weight (25c/oz).
table orders:
  customer: principal
  weightOz: int 1..3200
  priceCents: int 0..1000000
  tagPhoto: image <=5000000
  status: enum('washing', 'drying', 'folding', 'ready', 'pickedup', 'donated') default 'washing'
  route: text 1..40
  droppedAt: time default now
  readyAt: time ?
  pickedUpAt: time ?
  immutable customer, weightOz, droppedAt
  read <- .customer = viewer or exists roles[viewer, role = 'attendant'] or exists roles[viewer, role = 'owner'] or exists driverRoutes[viewer, route = .route]
  insert <- exists roles[viewer, role = 'attendant'] or exists roles[viewer, role = 'owner']
  update <- exists roles[viewer, role = 'attendant'] or exists roles[viewer, role = 'owner'] or .customer = viewer
  online only

-- A customer's lost/damaged claim; only the owner decides it.
table claims:
  order: orders
  customer: principal
  reason: enum('lost', 'damaged')
  detail: text 1..500
  status: enum('pending', 'approved', 'denied') default 'pending'
  refundCents: int ?
  at: time default now
  unique order else ALREADY_CLAIMED 'This order already has a claim.'
  immutable order, customer, reason, detail, at
  read <- .customer = viewer or exists roles[viewer, role = 'owner']
  insert <- .customer = viewer
  update <- exists roles[viewer, role = 'owner']
  online only

query myRole():
  return roles[viewer]

query allRoles(c: cursor ?):
  require exists roles[viewer, role = 'owner'] else NOT_OWNER
  return roles first 50 by .id after c

query myOrders(c: cursor ?):
  return orders where .customer = viewer last 50 by .droppedAt after c { *, overdue: .droppedAt + 2d < now and (.status = 'washing' or .status = 'drying' or .status = 'folding') }

query receipt(order: orders):
  return orders[order]

query receipts(c: cursor ?):
  return orders where .customer = viewer and (.status = 'ready' or .status = 'pickedup') last 50 by .droppedAt after c

query board(c: cursor ?):
  require exists roles[viewer, role = 'attendant'] or exists roles[viewer, role = 'owner'] else NOT_STAFF
  return orders where .status = 'washing' or .status = 'drying' or .status = 'folding' or .status = 'ready' last 100 by .droppedAt after c { *, overdue: .droppedAt + 2d < now and (.status = 'washing' or .status = 'drying' or .status = 'folding') }

query flagged(c: cursor ?):
  require exists roles[viewer, role = 'attendant'] or exists roles[viewer, role = 'owner'] else NOT_STAFF
  return orders where .droppedAt + 2d < now and (.status = 'washing' or .status = 'drying' or .status = 'folding') last 100 by .droppedAt after c

query myRouteOrders(c: cursor ?):
  require exists roles[viewer, role = 'driver'] else NOT_DRIVER
  r = driverRoutes[viewer] ! else NO_ROUTE 'No route assigned to this driver.'
  return orders where .route = r.route last 100 by .droppedAt after c

query myRoute():
  return driverRoutes[viewer]

query routes(c: cursor ?):
  require exists roles[viewer, role = 'attendant'] or exists roles[viewer, role = 'owner'] else NOT_STAFF
  return driverRoutes last 50 by .id after c

query myClaims(c: cursor ?):
  return claims where .customer = viewer last 50 by .at after c

query allClaims(c: cursor ?):
  require exists roles[viewer, role = 'owner'] else NOT_OWNER
  return claims last 50 by .at after c

mutation provision(principal: principal, role: enum('customer', 'attendant', 'driver', 'owner')):
  require viewer = 'service:operator' or exists roles[viewer, role = 'owner'] else NOT_OPERATOR
  return upsert roles[principal] { principal, role }

mutation assignRoute(driver: principal, route: text 1..40):
  require viewer = 'service:operator' or exists roles[viewer, role = 'owner'] else NOT_OWNER
  require exists roles[driver, role = 'driver'] else NOT_DRIVER
  return upsert driverRoutes[driver] { driver, route }

mutation dropOff(customer: principal, weightOz: int 1..3200, tagPhoto: image <=5000000, route: text 1..40):
  require exists roles[viewer, role = 'attendant'] or exists roles[viewer, role = 'owner'] else NOT_ATTENDANT
  require exists roles[customer, role = 'customer'] else NOT_CUSTOMER 'Drop-offs are logged for customer accounts.'
  return insert orders { customer, weightOz, priceCents: weightOz * 25, tagPhoto, route }

mutation advanceStatus(order: orders, status: enum('drying', 'folding', 'ready')):
  o = orders[order] ! else NOT_FOUND
  require exists roles[viewer, role = 'attendant'] or exists roles[viewer, role = 'owner'] else NOT_STAFF
  require (o.status = 'washing' and status = 'drying') or (o.status = 'drying' and status = 'folding') or (o.status = 'folding' and status = 'ready') else BAD_TRANSITION 'Bags move washing -> drying -> folding -> ready.'
  update orders[order] { status, readyAt: now if status = 'ready' else o.readyAt }
  return null

mutation pickup(order: orders):
  o = orders[order] ! else NOT_FOUND
  require o.customer = viewer or exists roles[viewer, role = 'attendant'] or exists roles[viewer, role = 'owner'] else NOT_YOURS
  require o.status = 'ready' else NOT_READY 'This bag is not ready for pickup.'
  require (o.readyAt ?? 0) > now - 30d else TOO_LATE 'Unclaimed bags are donated after 30 days.'
  update orders[order] { status: 'pickedup', pickedUpAt: now }
  return null

mutation fileClaim(order: orders, reason: enum('lost', 'damaged'), detail: text 1..500):
  o = orders[order] ! else NOT_FOUND
  require o.customer = viewer else NOT_YOURS 'Claims are filed by the order owner.'
  return insert claims { order, customer: viewer, reason, detail }

mutation decideClaim(claim: claims, approve: bool, refundCents: int ?):
  c = claims[claim] ! else NOT_FOUND
  require exists roles[viewer, role = 'owner'] else NOT_OWNER 'Only the store owner approves refunds.'
  require c.status = 'pending' else ALREADY_DECIDED 'This claim was already decided.'
  require not approve or (refundCents ?? 0) > 0 else BAD_REFUND 'An approved refund needs an amount.'
  require approve or refundCents = null else BAD_REFUND 'A denied claim carries no amount.'
  update claims[claim] { status: 'approved' if approve else 'denied', refundCents }
  return null

job donateUnclaimed(periodStart: time, periodEnd: time):
  for o in orders by .id:
    if o.status = 'ready' and (o.readyAt ?? 0) < periodEnd - 30d:
      update orders[o.id] { status: 'donated' }

schedule daily every 1d at 06:00: donateUnclaimed

//! Validate the complete command before any project, store or host work.
// @ref LLP 3000.000.000.000.000#4-cli-surface-contracts — admission, every synopsis and flag help share this command table.
use std::sync::OnceLock;
#[derive(serde::Deserialize)]
struct Flag { name: String, value: String, #[serde(default)] retired: bool }
#[derive(serde::Deserialize)]
struct Command { verb: String, positional: String, flags: Vec<Flag>, #[serde(skip)] allowed: String }
fn commands() -> &'static [Command] {
    static TABLE: OnceLock<Vec<Command>> = OnceLock::new();
    TABLE.get_or_init(|| {
        let mut commands: Vec<Command> = serde_json::from_str(include_str!("../../../packages/snapback4/bin/cli-commands.json")).expect("embedded command table");
        for command in &mut commands { command.allowed = command.flags.iter().map(|flag|flag.name.as_str()).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(" "); }
        commands
    })
}
fn command(verb: &str) -> Option<&'static Command> { commands().iter().find(|command|command.verb==verb) }
pub(crate) fn allowed(verb: &str) -> &'static str { command(verb).map_or("", |command| command.allowed.as_str()) }

pub fn validate(args: &[String]) -> Result<(), String> {
    let verb = args.first().map(String::as_str).unwrap_or("");
    // Pipe-owned private commands have positional protocols, not public flags.
    if matches!(verb, "--internal-witness-process" | "--internal-worker-watchdog") { return Ok(()); }
    let mut iter = args.iter().skip(1).peekable();
    while let Some(arg) = iter.next() {
        if arg == "--" { break; }
        if arg == "-h" { continue; }
        let Some(flag) = arg.strip_prefix("--") else {
            if arg.starts_with('-') && !arg[1..].starts_with(|c: char| c.is_ascii_digit()) {
                return Err(if verb == "witness" { "E_INPUT: witness has an invalid flag; see guide witness".into() } else { format!("E_INPUT: {verb} takes no {arg}") });
            }
            continue;
        };
        let (name, inline) = flag.split_once('=').map_or((flag, None), |(name, value)| (name, Some(value)));
        if name != "help" && !allowed(verb).split_whitespace().any(|known| known == name) {
            if verb == "rollback" && name == "dry-run" { return Err("E_INPUT: rollback preview is --check; use rollback <dir> [--to N|latest] --check".into()); }
            // Witness arguments may contain bearer material even in a flag name.
            return Err(if verb == "witness" { "E_INPUT: witness has an unknown flag; see guide witness".into() } else { format!("E_INPUT: {verb} takes no --{name}") });
        }
        if switch(name) {
            if inline.is_some() { return Err(format!("E_INPUT: {verb} --{name} takes no value")); }
        } else if inline.is_none() {
            // Retired spellings route to their existing no-work explanation,
            // even with a missing value; new unknown flags still refuse here.
            if retired(verb,name) {
                if iter.peek().is_some_and(|value| !value.starts_with("--")) { iter.next(); }
                continue;
            }
            let Some(value) = iter.next() else { return Err(format!("E_INPUT: {verb} --{name} needs a value")); };
            // Search text is literal, including leading dashes and punctuation.
            if value.starts_with("--") && !matches!(name, "find" | "section") {
                return Err(format!("E_INPUT: {verb} --{name} needs a value"));
            }
        }
    }
    let has = |name: &str| args.iter().skip(1).any(|arg| arg == &format!("--{name}") || arg.starts_with(&format!("--{name}=")));
    if verb == "check" {
        if has("ack-security")!=has("reason"){return Err("E_INPUT: --ack-security ID requires --reason TEXT".into());}
        if has("ack-security")&&["ack-notes","fix","store","release","emit-lean","audit"].iter().any(|f|has(f)){return Err("E_INPUT: individual security review cannot combine with --ack-notes, --fix, saved-store/release, --emit-lean or --audit".into());}
        if has("release") && !has("store") { return Err("E_INPUT: check --release requires --store <path>".into()); }
        if has("as") && !has("residency") { return Err("E_INPUT: check --as requires --residency".into()); }
        let incompatible = if has("emit-lean") { Some(("--emit-lean", &["cost","residency","fix","verbose","store","fixture","as","release","ack-notes","audit"][..])) }
            else if has("release") { Some(("--store --release", &["cost","residency","fix","fixture","as","ack-notes"][..])) } else { None };
        if let Some((mode,flags)) = incompatible {
            if let Some(flag) = flags.iter().find(|flag|has(flag)) { return Err(format!("E_INPUT: check {mode} does not accept --{flag}")); }
        }
    }
    if verb == "serve" && has("wait-stopped") && args.iter().any(|arg|arg.starts_with("--") && !matches!(arg.as_str(),"--wait-stopped"|"--help")) {
        return Err("E_INPUT: serve --wait-stopped takes only a deployment directory; it does not start or signal a server".into());
    }
    if verb == "rollback" && has("bridge") && !has("check") { return Err("E_INPUT: rollback --bridge requires --check; it writes a bridge starter without activating it".into()); }
    if verb == "check" && has("audit") && ["cost","residency","fix","store","fixture","as","release","emit-lean","ack-notes"].iter().any(|f|has(f)) { return Err("E_INPUT: check --audit takes only --json or --verbose".into()); }
    if verb == "test" && has("verbose") && !has("residency") { return Err("E_INPUT: test --verbose requires --residency".into()); }
    if verb == "run" && has("token-env") && !has("release") { return Err("E_INPUT: run --token-env requires --release".into()); }
    if verb == "why" && has("instance") && crate::verbs::parse(args).positionals.first().map(String::as_str) != Some("recent") { return Err("E_INPUT: why --instance requires why recent".into()); }
    if verb == "token" && has("port") && has("release") { return Err("E_INPUT: token --port selects dev and cannot combine with --release".into()); }
    if verb == "token" && has("quiet") && has("json") { return Err("E_INPUT: token takes either --quiet or --json".into()); }
    Ok(())
}

fn retired(verb: &str, name: &str) -> bool {
    command(verb).is_some_and(|command|command.flags.iter().any(|flag|flag.name==name && flag.retired))
}
pub fn switch(name: &str) -> bool { name=="help" || commands().iter().flat_map(|command|&command.flags).any(|flag|flag.name==name && flag.value.is_empty()) }

#[cfg(test)]
mod integration_tests {
    use super::*;
    #[test]
    fn wave9_web_flags_and_upgrade_keep_shared_validation() {
        let args = ["witness", "web", "dist", "--url", "http://127.0.0.1", "--as", "alice", "--email", "alice@example.test", "--password-env", "PRIVATE_PASSWORD", "--mutation", "add", "--args", "{}", "--timeout", "30", "--export", "dist"].map(String::from);
        assert!(validate(&args).is_ok());
        for verb in ["upgrade", "witness"] {
            assert!(validate(&[verb.into(), "--unknown-wave9".into()]).is_err());
        }
        assert!(validate(&["upgrade".into(), "0.4.25".into()]).is_ok());
        assert!(validate(&["upgrade".into(), "--to".into(), "0.4.25".into(), "--json".into()]).is_ok());
        assert!(validate(&["witness".into(), "web".into(), "--password-env".into()]).is_err());
    }
}

fn value(verb: &str, name: &str) -> String {
    command(verb).and_then(|command|command.flags.iter().find(|flag|flag.name==name)).filter(|flag|!flag.value.is_empty()).map(|flag|format!(" {}",flag.value)).unwrap_or_default()
}
