#[cfg(test)]
mod projection_tests {
    #[test]
    fn every_validated_flag_is_in_its_generated_help() {
        for verb in ["init","new","audit","check","device","types","dev","deploy","rollback","prune","releases","serve","run","clock","seed","reset","test","why","guide","data","sql","token","doctor","upgrade","witness"] {
            let page = super::help(verb);
            for name in super::allowed(verb).split_whitespace() {
                assert!(page.lines().any(|line|line.trim_start().starts_with(&format!("--{name}"))),"{verb}: {name}");
                let args = if super::switch(name) { vec![verb.into(), format!("--{name}")] } else { vec![verb.into(), format!("--{name}"), "value".into()] };
                let mut args = args;
                if verb == "check" && name == "as" { args.push("--residency".into()); }
                if verb == "check" && name == "release" { args.extend(["--store".into(), "value".into()]); }
                if verb == "test" && name == "verbose" { args.push("--residency".into()); }
                if verb == "run" && name == "token-env" { args.extend(["--release".into(), "value".into()]); }
                if verb == "why" && name == "instance" { args.insert(1, "recent".into()); }
                if verb == "rollback" && name == "bridge" { args.push("--check".into()); }
                assert!(super::validate(&args).is_ok(),"{args:?}");
                if super::retired(verb,name) { assert!(page.lines().find(|line|line.trim_start().starts_with(&format!("--{name} "))).unwrap().contains("retired spelling")); }
            }
        }
    }
}

/// One synopsis for top-level help, per-verb help and usage errors. Flags come
/// directly from the admission table, including value arity and retired forms.
pub(crate) const VERBS: &[&str] = &["init","new","audit","check","device","types","dev","deploy","rollback","prune","releases","serve","run","clock","seed","reset","test","why","guide","data","sql","token","doctor","upgrade","witness","web-shell"];
pub(crate) fn synopsis(verb: &str) -> String {
    let positional = command(verb).map(|command|command.positional.as_str()).filter(|position|!position.is_empty()).map(|position|format!(" {position}")).unwrap_or_default();
    let mut out = format!("snapback4 {verb}{positional}");
    for name in allowed(verb).split_whitespace().filter(|name| !retired(verb,name)) {
        let value = value(verb, name);
        out.push_str(&format!(" [--{name}{value}]"));
    }
    out
}
pub(crate) fn top_help() -> String {
    let mut out = String::from("snapback4 — the scale-to-zero backend with a partition on every device\n\n");
    for verb in VERBS { out.push_str(&format!("  {}\n      {}\n", synopsis(verb), match *verb {
        "init"=>"Create a schema or a web/Expo starter; init --adapt fits an existing starter.",
        "new"=>"Create a full reference app: --template social, or chat with --web/--expo.",
        "audit"=>"Report security intent, conditional exposure paths and grant writers.",
        "check"=>"Compile the schema, check store adoption, write client types and report readiness.",
        "device"=>"Run the native device JSON protocol over stdin/stdout.", "types"=>"Compile and write generated client types.",
        "dev"=>"Serve a development backend; print its URL on stdout, readiness and refusals on stderr.",
        "deploy"=>"Capture and activate an immutable release; running serve adopts it.", "rollback"=>"Preview or activate an existing release; preserve dormant storage.",
        "prune"=>"Preview or explicitly remove dormant release storage.", "releases"=>"Inspect database-authoritative release history and storage.",
        "serve"=>"Serve the active production release; bearer sessions only, behind a TLS proxy.",
        "run"=>"Run one operation or system job locally or against a serving backend.",
        "clock"=>"Advance the development clock, sweep expiry and run due jobs.", "reset"=>"Empty a development backend and optionally reseed it atomically.",
        "test"=>"Load fixtures, run cases and sweep queries as their personas; --residency: acquisition report only; add --verbose to run queries and print meters.", "why"=>"Explain a diagnostic, operation, table, work id or recent refusal.",
        "guide"=>"List cards or read a card/alias; --sections indexes it, --section selects one.",
        "data"=>"Inspect stored rows as an administrator; bypasses read rules.", "sql"=>"Read-only administrative SQL inspection; bypasses read rules.",
        "token"=>"Mint a service seat's bearer; --quiet is token-only, --json returns metadata.",
        "doctor"=>"Inspect backend health or latency; --json returns a machine-readable report.",
        "upgrade"=>"Upgrade core and installed adapters together; --to permits an explicit downgrade.",
        "witness"=>"Prove browser writes, device acquisition or installed iOS behavior.", "web-shell"=>"Install an offline shell for a static web export (npm wrapper).", _=>"",
    })); }
    out.push_str("  snapback4 --version\n\nsnapback4 <verb> --help explains each flag, output and exit codes.");
    out
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod surface_tests {
    use super::*;
    #[test]
    fn every_help_and_usage_projects_the_same_synopsis() {
        let top = top_help();
        assert_eq!(commands().iter().map(|command|command.verb.as_str()).collect::<Vec<_>>(), VERBS);
        for verb in VERBS {
            let synopsis = synopsis(verb);
            assert!(top.lines().any(|line| line.trim() == synopsis), "{verb}");
            assert_eq!(crate::verb_help::page(verb).unwrap().lines().next(), Some(synopsis.as_str()), "{verb}");
            let actual = synopsis.split("[--").skip(1).map(|part|part.split([' ',']']).next().unwrap()).collect::<Vec<_>>();
            let expected = allowed(verb).split_whitespace().filter(|flag| !retired(verb,flag)).collect::<Vec<_>>();
            assert_eq!(actual, expected, "{verb}");
        }
        assert!(synopsis("deploy").contains("[--schema file.q]"));
        assert!(synopsis("init").contains("[--port-range A-B]"));
        assert!(synopsis("upgrade").contains("[--to version]"));
    }
    #[test]
    fn ignored_flags_refuse_before_any_work() {
        for args in [vec!["check","--url","notaurl"],vec!["check","--release","1"],vec!["types","--json"],vec!["test","--json"],vec!["test","--verbose"],vec!["doctor","--instance","x"],vec!["run","x","--token-env","SECRET"],vec!["why","E_INPUT","--json"],vec!["why","E_INPUT","--instance","x"],vec!["reset","--release","x"],vec!["serve","x","--resume-clock"],vec!["serve","x","--now","1"],vec!["serve","x","--replay"]] {
            assert!(validate(&args.iter().map(|s|s.to_string()).collect::<Vec<_>>()).unwrap_err().starts_with("E_INPUT:"), "{args:?}");
        }
        assert!(validate(&["why","--instance","x","recent"].map(String::from)).is_ok());
        for suffix in [vec!["--as","alice"], vec!["--emit-lean","source.q","--cost"],vec!["--emit-lean","source.q","--store","db"],vec!["--store","db","--release","1","--fix"],vec!["--store","db","--release","1","--fixture","fixtures"]] {
            let args=std::iter::once("check").chain(suffix).map(String::from).collect::<Vec<_>>();
            assert!(validate(&args).unwrap_err().starts_with("E_INPUT:"),"{args:?}");
        }
    }
}

//! `check`'s advisory notes, ranked. A green check printed nine notes in
//! source order, and builders could not tell an FYI about offline coverage
//! from a page that never completes. Notes stay advisory (they never fail a
//! check); this only orders them, names each group, and shortens repeats.

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord, Debug)]
pub(crate) enum Tier {
    /// Can cost correctness or completeness: a page that never completes, a
    /// write no caller can pass, a disclosure, a read a device cannot answer.
    Review,
    /// Costs speed, meter headroom or offline coverage.
    Performance,
    /// What a declaration implies; nothing to fix for online use.
    Design,
}

pub(crate) fn tier(code: &str) -> Tier {
    if snapback4_lang::security::note_priority(code)<=2{return Tier::Review;}
    match code {
        "N_IMMUTABLE_PATCH" | "N_PERSONA_PRINCIPAL" | "N_UNREADABLE_PROBE" | "N_NO_PRODUCTION_WRITER" | "N_FIXTURE_ARGUMENT_DRIFT" | "N_REFERENCE_UNCHECKED" | "N_MAINTAIN_AUTHORIZATION" | "N_WRITE_DENIED" | "N_DELETE_RESTRICTED" | "N_DELETE_NEEDS_READ" | "N_PATCH_CLEARS" | "N_NEVER_COMPLETE" | "N_CONDITIONAL_COMPLETE" | "N_PROBE_ONLY_READ" | "N_VACUOUS_RULE" | "N_LOOKUP_HIDDEN" | "N_LOOKUP_FILTERED" | "N_UNIQUE_HIDDEN" | "N_LOOKUP_NEVER_VISIBLE" | "N_REQUIRE_HIDDEN" | "N_REQUIRE_REFUSED" | "N_QUERY_FILTERED" | "N_SHAPE_METER" | "N_HELD_UNKNOWN" | "N_SEQUENCE_READ"
        | "N_SWEEP_DEADLINE" | "N_CLOCK_STORE_AHEAD" | "N_PUBLIC_AGGREGATE_COPY" | "N_MAINTAINED_COLUMN_DISCLOSURE" | "N_MAINTAIN_DELTA"
        | "N_INSERT_WRITE_INTENT" | "N_COLUMN_RESULT_EXPOSURE" | "N_SEARCH_UNSCOPED" | "N_SEARCH_OPEN" | "N_TIMELINE_PROFILE_CAP" | "N_PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION" | "N_SELF_CLAIMED_RELATIONSHIP" | "N_CALLER_TIME" | "N_ROLE_WIDE_READ" | "N_INVARIANT_RESTATES_RULE" | "N_ARGUMENT_GRANT" | "N_BROAD_READ" | "N_SECURITY_INTENT" => Tier::Review,
        // @ref LLP 3000.036#13.4 — a cursorless `first N` is what the declaration says: the first N rows (wave 3 #7).
        "N_SYNC_ORDER" | "N_NO_HORIZON" | "N_MAINTAIN_SYNCED" | "N_TIMELINE_COMPAT" | "N_NO_CURSOR" => Tier::Design,
        _ => Tier::Performance,
    }
}

/// Security findings that can grant authority stay ahead of repeated advice.
pub(crate) fn summary_order(code:&str)->(Tier,u8){
    let priority=snapback4_lang::security::note_priority(code);
    (if priority<=2 {Tier::Review}else{tier(code)},priority)
}

pub(crate) fn site_order(site:&str)->(String,u32,u32){
    let mut parts=site.rsplitn(3,':');let col=parts.next().and_then(|s|s.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(0);let line=parts.next().and_then(|s|s.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(0);let file=parts.next().unwrap_or(site);(file.to_owned(),line,col)
}

/// The first words of a note's line: what to do about it, or that nothing
/// needs doing (wave 7 #11: "put a one-line verdict on every advisory note").
// @ref LLP 3000.036#17.7 — the verdict leads; the explanation follows it.
pub(crate) fn verdict(code: &str, summary: &str, form: bool) -> &'static str {
    match code {
        "N_PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION" => "review: restrict authority assignment",
        "N_SELF_CLAIMED_RELATIONSHIP" => "review: verify the relationship before granting access",
        "N_CALLER_TIME" => "review: use server time or bound the supplied time",
        "N_ROLE_WIDE_WRITE" | "N_ROLE_WIDE_READ" | "N_BROAD_READ" => "review: confirm each admitted audience and row state",
        "N_INVARIANT_RESTATES_RULE" => "review: answer the audience questions from the spec",
        "N_SECURITY_INTENT" => "review: write independent intent from the spec",
        "N_NO_PRODUCTION_WRITER" if summary.starts_with("persona-only:") => "no action without use identity",
        "N_NO_PRODUCTION_WRITER" => "fix: add a production bootstrap writer",
        "N_FIXTURE_ARGUMENT_DRIFT" => "fix: update the fixture arguments",
        "N_CONDITIONAL_COMPLETE" => "review: complete for the pinned parent audience; other callers may be capped",
        "N_NEVER_COMPLETE" if summary.contains("the complete form is to add `cap ") => "fix: add the exact source cap below, or accept `complete: false`",
        "N_NEVER_COMPLETE" if summary.contains("no verified complete form for this read") => "review: no verified complete form for this read; expect `capped` and show what arrived",
        "N_NEVER_COMPLETE" if form && summary.contains("the closest form is") => "fix: use the closest form below (one arm stays `complete: false`), or accept `complete: false`",
        "N_NEVER_COMPLETE" if form => "fix: use the complete form below, or accept `complete: false`",
        "N_NEVER_COMPLETE" => "fix: pin the scope, or accept `complete: false`",
        "N_DELETE_RESTRICTED" => "fix: declare the reference's `on delete`, or guard the delete",
        "N_DELETE_NEEDS_READ" => "review: some deleters get NOT_FOUND",
        "N_REFERENCE_UNCHECKED" => "review: this reference argument has no mandatory target lookup",
        "N_MAINTAIN_AUTHORIZATION" => "review: hidden and absent are different caller outcomes",
        "N_PATCH_CLEARS" => "review: an omitted argument clears this column",
        "N_WRITE_DENIED" if summary.contains("admits only 'service:") => "review: a seat require grants no table authority",
        "N_WRITE_DENIED" => "fix: this write refuses E_RULE for callers you admit",
        "N_REQUIRE_REFUSED" => "review: callers you admit may still get E_RULE",
        "N_QUERY_FILTERED" => "review: this query branch may filter rows under table authority",
        "N_READ_DENIED" => "fix: this read always returns null",
        "N_REQUIRE_HIDDEN" if summary.contains("get NOT_FOUND") => "review: the hidden lookup runs before this require",
        "N_REQUIRE_HIDDEN" => "fix: this require cannot see the rows it tests",
        "N_LOOKUP_NEVER_VISIBLE" => "fix: this nullable lookup is always null for the admitted callers",
        "N_LOOKUP_HIDDEN" => "review: a required read gate may hide rows from writers",
        "N_LOOKUP_FILTERED" => "review: confirm lookup authority and the hidden-row outcome",
        "N_UNIQUE_HIDDEN" => "review: hidden unique conflicts retain generic E_RULE",
        "N_PROBE_ONLY_READ" | "N_PUBLIC_AGGREGATE_COPY" | "N_MAINTAINED_COLUMN_DISCLOSURE" => "review: who can read this",
        "N_VACUOUS_RULE" => "review: who can write this",
        "N_INSERT_WRITE_INTENT" => "review: confirm creation authority as well as edit authority",
        "N_COLUMN_RESULT_EXPOSURE" => "review: confirm every result/refusal audience",
        "N_IMMUTABLE_PATCH" => "review: readable conflicts require the original immutable value",
        "N_NO_CURSOR" => "no action for a top-N list",
        _ => match tier(code) {
            Tier::Review => "review",
            Tier::Performance => "no action unless it is slow (`check --cost` measures it)",
            Tier::Design => "no action for an online app",
        },
    }
}

fn heading(tier: Tier) -> &'static str {
    match tier {
        Tier::Review => "review — can cost correctness or completeness:",
        Tier::Performance => "performance — costs speed, meter headroom or offline coverage:",
        Tier::Design => "by design — what a declaration implies; no action needed for online use:",
    }
}

//! A project on disk: `snapback/*.q` is the backend, `snapback/generated/`
//! is built, `.snapback4/` is the data directory. Nothing here is committed
//! except the `.q` files.

use snapback4_core::{Engine, RuntimeError, store_port::AnyStore};
use snapback4_lang::{Bound, compile};
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

pub struct Project {
    pub root: PathBuf,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct SourceStamp { sources: u128, dependencies: u128 }
type ServerDependency = (String, Option<(String, String)>);

fn stamp(value: impl std::fmt::Debug) -> u128 {
    use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
    let hash = Sha256::digest(format!("{value:?}"));
    u128::from_be_bytes(hash[..16].try_into().expect("sixteen hash bytes"))
}

impl Project {
    /// Walk up from `start` to the directory holding any `snapback/*.q`.
    // @ref LLP 3000.011.003.000#7.1 — any Quarry module is the project; no invented root schema is needed.
    pub fn locate(start: &Path) -> Option<Self> {
        let mut dir = Some(start.to_path_buf());
        while let Some(current) = dir {
            if std::fs::read_dir(current.join("snapback")).ok().is_some_and(|entries| entries.flatten().any(|entry| entry.file_name().to_string_lossy().ends_with(".q") && entry.path().is_file())) {
                return Some(Self { root: current });
            }
            dir = current.parent().map(Path::to_path_buf);
        }
        None
    }

    pub fn schema_dir(&self) -> PathBuf {
        self.root.join("snapback")
    }

    pub fn server_source(&self) -> Option<PathBuf> {
        ["snapback/server.ts", "snapback/server.mts", "snapback/server.mjs"].into_iter().map(|p| self.root.join(p)).find(|p| p.is_file())
    }

    pub fn generated_dir(&self) -> PathBuf {
        self.schema_dir().join("generated")
    }

    /// The app's native crate (LLP 3000.005), when it has one.
    pub fn native_dir(&self) -> PathBuf {
        self.schema_dir().join("native")
    }

    pub fn native_manifest(&self) -> PathBuf {
        self.native_dir().join("Cargo.toml")
    }

    /// The built module, beside the generated types.
    pub fn native_module(&self) -> PathBuf {
        self.generated_dir().join("native.wasm")
    }

    /// The schema's Rust types for the native crate to include.
    pub fn native_types(&self) -> PathBuf {
        self.generated_dir().join("native.rs")
    }

    pub fn data_dir(&self) -> PathBuf {
        self.root.join(".snapback4")
    }

    pub fn store_path(&self) -> PathBuf {
        self.data_dir().join("store.sqlite")
    }

    /// Every `.q` file under `snapback/`, `schema.q` first, as `(name, text)`.
    pub fn sources(&self) -> std::io::Result<Vec<(String, String)>> {
        let mut names: Vec<String> = std::fs::read_dir(self.schema_dir())?
            .flatten()
            .filter_map(|entry| {
                let name = entry.file_name().to_string_lossy().to_string();
                (name.ends_with(".q") && entry.path().is_file()).then_some(name)
            })
            .collect();
        names.sort();
        if let Some(position) = names.iter().position(|n| n == "schema.q") {
            let schema = names.remove(position);
            names.insert(0, schema);
        }
        names.into_iter().map(|name| Ok((name.clone(), std::fs::read_to_string(self.schema_dir().join(&name))?))).collect()
    }

    pub fn saved_copy_hint(&self) -> Option<String> {
        let sources = self.sources().ok()?;
        let tables: Vec<_> = sources.iter().map(|(file, text)| (file, snapback4_lang::parse_document(file, text).0.tables.into_iter().map(|t| t.name).collect::<std::collections::BTreeSet<_>>())).collect();
        for (i, (file, names)) in tables.iter().enumerate() {
            if names.is_empty() { continue; }
            for (other, next) in &tables[i + 1..] {
                if names == next { return Some(format!("{file} and {other} declare the same tables — a saved copy? keep saved sources outside snapback/")); }
            }

  immutable customer, weightOz, droppedAt
  read <- .customer = viewer or exists roles[viewer, role = 'attendant'] or exists roles[viewer, role = 'owner'] or exists driverRoutes[viewer, route = .route]
  insert <- exists roles[viewer, role = 'attendant'] or exists roles[viewer, role = 'owner']
  update <- exists roles[viewer, role = 'attendant'] or exists roles[viewer, role = 'owner'] or .customer = viewer
  online only

-- A customer's lost/damaged claim; only the owner decides it.
table claims:
  order: orders
  customer: principal
  reason: enum('lost', 'damaged')
  detail: text 1..500
  status: enum('pending', 'approved', 'denied') default 'pending'
  refundCents: int ?
  at: time default now
  unique order else ALREADY_CLAIMED 'This order already has a claim.'
  immutable order, customer, reason, detail, at
  read <- .customer = viewer or exists roles[viewer, role = 'owner']
  insert <- .customer = viewer
  update <- exists roles[viewer, role = 'owner']
  online only

query myRole():
  return roles[viewer]

query allRoles(c: cursor ?):
  require exists roles[viewer, role = 'owner'] else NOT_OWNER
  return roles first 50 by .id after c

query myOrders(c: cursor ?):
  return orders where .customer = viewer last 50 by .droppedAt after c { *, overdue: .droppedAt + 2d < now and (.status = 'washing' or .status = 'drying' or .status = 'folding') }

query receipt(order: orders):
  return orders[order]

query receipts(c: cursor ?):
  return orders where .customer = viewer and (.status = 'ready' or .status = 'pickedup') last 50 by .droppedAt after c

query board(c: cursor ?):
  require exists roles[viewer, role = 'attendant'] or exists roles[viewer, role = 'owner'] else NOT_STAFF
  return orders where .status = 'washing' or .status = 'drying' or .status = 'folding' or .status = 'ready' last 100 by .droppedAt after c { *, overdue: .droppedAt + 2d < now and (.status = 'washing' or .status = 'drying' or .status = 'folding') }

query flagged(c: cursor ?):
  require exists roles[viewer, role = 'attendant'] or exists roles[viewer, role = 'owner'] else NOT_STAFF
  return orders where .droppedAt + 2d < now and (.status = 'washing' or .status = 'drying' or .status = 'folding') last 100 by .droppedAt after c

query myRouteOrders(c: cursor ?):
  require exists roles[viewer, role = 'driver'] else NOT_DRIVER
  r = driverRoutes[viewer] ! else NO_ROUTE 'No route assigned to this driver.'
  return orders where .route = r.route last 100 by .droppedAt after c

query myRoute():
  return driverRoutes[viewer]

query routes(c: cursor ?):
  require exists roles[viewer, role = 'attendant'] or exists roles[viewer, role = 'owner'] else NOT_STAFF
  return driverRoutes last 50 by .id after c

query myClaims(c: cursor ?):
  return claims where .customer = viewer last 50 by .at after c

query allClaims(c: cursor ?):
  require exists roles[viewer, role = 'owner'] else NOT_OWNER
  return claims last 50 by .at after c

mutation provision(principal: principal, role: enum('customer', 'attendant', 'driver', 'owner')):
  require viewer = 'service:operator' or exists roles[viewer, role = 'owner'] else NOT_OPERATOR
  return upsert roles[principal] { principal, role }

mutation assignRoute(driver: principal, route: text 1..40):
  require viewer = 'service:operator' or exists roles[viewer, role = 'owner'] else NOT_OWNER
  require exists roles[driver, role = 'driver'] else NOT_DRIVER
  return upsert driverRoutes[driver] { driver, route }

mutation dropOff(customer: principal, weightOz: int 1..3200, tagPhoto: image <=5000000, route: text 1..40):
  require exists roles[viewer, role = 'attendant'] or exists roles[viewer, role = 'owner'] else NOT_ATTENDANT
  require exists roles[customer, role = 'customer'] else NOT_CUSTOMER 'Drop-offs are logged for customer accounts.'
  return insert orders { customer, weightOz, priceCents: weightOz * 25, tagPhoto, route }

  o = orders[order] ! else NOT_FOUND
    }

fn reserve_observers(out:&mut Campaign,calls:usize)->bool{
    if !out.reserve(calls){return false;}
    if out.history_observer_calls+calls>32768{out.unsupported.insert("history read observers capped at 32768 calls; remaining disclosure combinations not covered".into());false}else{out.history_observer_calls+=calls;true}
}
fn observe(bound:&Bound,e:&mut Engine,rows:&BTreeMap<String,Vec<Value>>,initial:&BTreeMap<String,Vec<Value>>,actors:&[String],steps:&[Step],out:&mut Campaign){
    if !reserve_observers(out,0)||out.history_observer_calls>=32768{return;}
    let queries=bound.programs.iter().filter(|bp|bp.program.kind==ProgramKind::Query&&!bp.program.native).filter(|bp|{
        let json=serde_json::to_string(&bp.program).unwrap();
        if ["NewId","Emit","JobAs","JobQuery"].iter().any(|tag|json.contains(tag)){
            out.unsupported.insert(format!("{}: generated-id/opaque history observer needs disclosure provenance",bp.program.name));false
        }else{true}
    }).collect::<Vec<_>>();
    if queries.is_empty(){return;}
    for inv in bound.invariants.iter().filter(|i|i.target=="read"){
        let direct=inv.policy.as_ref().is_some_and(|p|kernel::implies(&super::super::columns::admission(&bound.schema.tables[&inv.table],inv.column.as_deref()),p)==Ok(true));
        let indirect=bound.schema.maintains.iter().any(|m|m.source==inv.table)||bound.schema.tables.values().any(|t|super::super::columns::rules(t).any(|r|kernel::dependencies(r).contains(&inv.table)));
        if direct&&!indirect{continue;}

        let observing=observer_tables(bound,&inv.table);
        for row in rows.get(&inv.table).into_iter().flatten(){'actors:for viewer in actors{
            if out.exhausted(){return;}
            if out.violations.iter().any(|v|v.invariant_site==inv.site.to_string()&&v.viewer==*viewer&&v.reachability==Reachability::AuthoredFixtureTrace&&trace_key(&v.history)==trace_key(steps)){continue;}
            if !reserve_observers(out,1){return;}
            match policy_in(bound,inv,rows,viewer,None,row,e){Ok(false)=>{},Ok(true)=>continue,Err(why)=>{out.unsupported.insert(format!("{}: {why}",inv.target_label()));continue;}}
            let Ok(key)=row.field("id")else{continue;};
            if inv.column.as_ref().and_then(|c|bound.schema.tables[&inv.table].written_by.get(c)).is_some_and(|gate|!gate.audience&&row.field(&gate.owner).ok()!=Some(&Value::Id(viewer.clone()))){continue 'actors;}

            // A typed authored row return is already a payload witness. It does
            // not require an invalid absent world that deletes referenced data.
            for bp in queries.iter().copied().filter(|p|typed_source(&p.result,&inv.table)){
                let cases=fixture_cases(bound,&bp.program,rows,actors,out);
                if cases.len()>32{out.unsupported.insert(format!("{}: typed read-observer arguments capped at 32",bp.program.name));}
                for args in cases.into_iter().take(32){
                    if !reserve_observers(out,2){return;}
                    let args=match materialize_arguments(e,&bp.program.args,&args,viewer){Ok(a)=>a,Err(why)=>{out.unsupported.insert(format!("{}: typed history observer asset/input preparation: {why}",bp.program.name));continue;}};
                    out.attempted+=1;
                    if let Ok(q)=e.query(&bp.program.name,Context::new(viewer,args.clone()).at(NOW))&&!q.unavailable&&typed_disclosure(&bp.result,&q.data,&inv.table,key,inv.column.as_deref(),row){
                        out.attempted+=1;
                        if !matches!(e.query(&bp.program.name,Context::new(viewer,args.clone()).at(NOW)),Ok(again) if !again.unavailable&&again.data==q.data){
            if old!=Some(row)||old.is_some_and(|r|prior_policy(bound,inv,before,viewer,Some(r),r,prior)==Ok(true)){
                violation(out,inv,steps,viewer,row,old,initial,"always");
            }
        }
    }
}
fn changed(bound:&Bound,_p:&Program,before:&BTreeMap<String,Vec<Value>>,after:&BTreeMap<String,Vec<Value>>,initial:&BTreeMap<String,Vec<Value>>,viewer:&str,steps:&[Step],prior:&mut Option<Engine>,current:&mut Engine,out:&mut Campaign){
    assertions(bound,before,after,initial,viewer,steps,prior,current,out);
    // Disappearance is coverage evidence only. Actual delete authority is
    // judged by the executed-write trace, never by a commit-end image diff.
    for inv in bound.invariants.iter().filter(|i|matches!(i.target.as_str(),"delete"|"write")){
        if bound.schema.tables[&inv.table].is_expiring()&&before.get(&inv.table).into_iter().flatten().any(|old|!after.get(&inv.table).into_iter().flatten().any(|new|new.field("id").ok()==old.field("id").ok())){
            out.unsupported.insert(format!("{}: implicit retirement is not an executed delete; delete intent requires an authored write boundary",inv.target_label()));
        }
    }
}

fn role_candidates<'a>(bound:&Bound,p:&'a Program,initial:&BTreeMap<String,Vec<Value>>,actors:&[String],cases:&[BTreeMap<String,Value>],fixture:&Engine,campaign:&mut Campaign)->Vec<(&'a Program,String,BTreeMap<String,Value>)>{
    let mut out=Vec::new();let mut groups=Vec::new();
    let json=serde_json::to_string(p).unwrap();
    if !ir::write_tables(p).iter().any(|(table,_)|!super::super::privilege::role_columns(bound,table).is_empty()){return out;}
    if !campaign.reserve(1){return Vec::new();}
    let Ok(mut judge)=fork(bound,fixture,Vec::new())else{return Vec::new();};
    for (table,_) in ir::write_tables(p){
        let columns=super::super::privilege::role_columns(bound,&table);
        if !columns.iter().any(|c|json.contains(&format!("\"{c}\":"))){continue;}
        let t=&bound.schema.tables[&table];
        for row in initial.get(&table).into_iter().flatten(){
            let principal=t.columns.iter().find_map(|(c,k)|matches!(k.required(),C::Principal).then(||row.field(c).ok()).flatten());
            let Some(principal)=principal else{continue;};
            let mut targets=Vec::new();
            for case in cases{
                let mut args=case.clone();
                for (name,kind) in &p.args{match kind{
                    ir::ArgType::Principal=>{args.insert(name.clone(),principal.clone());},
                    ir::ArgType::Ref{table:target} if target==&table=>{if let Ok(id)=row.field("id"){args.insert(name.clone(),id.clone());}},_=>{}
                }}
                if columns.iter().any(|c|args.get(c).is_some_and(|v|row.field(c).ok()==Some(v))){continue;}
                if !targets.contains(&args){targets.push(args);}
            }
            let mut row_cases=Vec::new();
            for actor in actors{
                let owner=columns.iter().filter_map(|c|t.written_by.get(c)).any(|a|row.field(&a.owner).ok()==Some(&Value::Id(actor.clone())));
                if !campaign.reserve(1){return out;}
                let gate=judge.fixture_policy(&t.update_rule_judged(),actor,Some(row),row,NOW).ok();
                if !owner&&gate!=Some(rules::Verdict::Readable){continue;}
                for args in &targets{row_cases.push((p,actor.clone(),args.clone()));}
            }
            groups.push(row_cases);
        }
    }
    for n in 0..groups.iter().map(Vec::len).max().unwrap_or(0){for g in &groups{if let Some(case)=g.get(n){out.push(case.clone());}}}
    out
}
// Prioritize actually admitted relationship changes rather than filling the
// history cap with cross-products rejected by a recipient-role require.
fn relationship_candidates<'a>(bound:&Bound,p:&'a Program,initial:&BTreeMap<String,Vec<Value>>,actors:&[String],cases:&[BTreeMap<String,Value>],fixture:&Engine,out:&mut Campaign)->Vec<(&'a Program,String,BTreeMap<String,Value>)>{
    let writes=ir::write_tables(p);
    if !p.args.values().any(|k|matches!(k,ir::ArgType::Principal))||!writes.iter().any(|(t,_)|super::super::privilege::role_columns(bound,t).is_empty()&&bound.schema.tables[t].columns.values().any(|k|matches!(k.required(),C::Principal))){return Vec::new();}
    let mut candidates=Vec::new();let mut attempts=0;
    let Ok(mut judge)=fixture.fork_fixture()else{return candidates;};
    for actor in actors{
        let allowed=writes.iter().any(|(t,kind)|super::super::privilege::role_columns(bound,t).is_empty()&&initial.get(t).into_iter().flatten().any(|row|{
            let table=&bound.schema.tables[t];let gates=if *kind=="insert"{vec![&table.rules.insert]}else{vec![&table.rules.insert,&table.rules.update]};
            gates.into_iter().any(|gate|matches!(judge.fixture_policy(gate,actor,Some(row),row,NOW),Ok(rules::Verdict::Readable)))
        }));
        if !allowed{continue;}
        for args in cases{
            if attempts>=128||candidates.len()>=16||!out.reserve(1){return candidates;}attempts+=1;
            let Ok(mut e)=fixture.fork_fixture()else{continue;};
            let Ok(materialized)=materialize_arguments(&mut e,&p.args,args,actor)else{continue;};
            if !matches!(e.mutate(&p.name,None,Context::new(actor,materialized).at(NOW)),Ok(r) if matches!(r.state,snapback4_core::WriteState::Sent{..})){continue;}
            let Ok(after)=readback(&e)else{continue;};
            if writes.iter().any(|(t,_)|initial.get(t).into_iter().flatten().any(|old|after.get(t).into_iter().flatten().find(|r|r.field("id").ok()==old.field("id").ok()).is_some_and(|new|bound.schema.tables[t].columns.iter().any(|(c,k)|matches!(k.required(),C::Principal)&&old.field(c).ok()!=new.field(c).ok())))){
                candidates.push((p,actor.clone(),args.clone()));
            }
        }
    }candidates
}

    if bound.invariants.is_empty()||out.exhausted(){return;}

//! CLI security reporting; compile/test evidence share one analyzer.
// @ref LLP 3000.036.004#5-exposure-report — full audit is opt-in, intent notes are on ordinary check.
use super::*;
use snapback4_lang::security::{self,Report};
mod http;
mod record;
pub(super) use record::{remember,capture};
pub(super) fn unauthenticated(bound:&Bound,sources:&[(String,String)])->bool {
    match http::run(bound,sources){Ok(_)=>true,Err(why)=>{eprintln!("security HTTP failure: {why}");false}}
}
pub(super) fn report(project:&Project,bound:&Bound,sources:&[(String,String)],options:&Options)->Report{
    let mut selection=options.clone();
    let selected_fixture=record::selected_fixture(project,options);
    if selected_fixture.is_dir(){selection.flags.insert("fixture".into(),selected_fixture.to_string_lossy().into_owned());}
    let inputs=match selection.flags.get("fixture"){
        Some(path)=>match super::test_fixture::snapshot(std::path::Path::new(path)){Ok(snapshot)=>Some(snapshot),Err(why)=>{let mut report=security::analyze_rules(bound);security::add_source_notes(&mut report,sources,bound);report.campaign_coverage.insert(format!("fixture reachability not covered: {why}"));return report;}},None=>None,
    };
    if let Some(snapshot)=&inputs{selection.flags.insert("fixture".into(),snapshot.0.to_string_lossy().into_owned());}
    let cached=record::matching(project,&selection,sources);
    let known_failure=cached.as_ref().is_some_and(|r|!r.violations.is_empty())&&!options.flags.contains_key("security-full");
    let mut campaign=if options.flags.contains_key("security-full"){security::challenges::Campaign::default()}else{security::challenges::Campaign::bounded(1500)};
    if known_failure {campaign.work_remaining=Some(0);campaign.unsupported.insert("matching full-test refutations retained; bounded resampling skipped; repair and rerun snapback4 test".into());}
    // An explicitly selected fixture remains the initial-state assumption.
    // Static generation runs only on the fixture-free path; both share this
    // one bounded campaign with all subsequent concrete exploration.
    let mut report=if selection.flags.contains_key("fixture")||known_failure{
        security::analyze_rules(bound)
    }else{security::analyze_with_campaign(bound,&mut campaign)};
    security::add_source_notes(&mut report,sources,bound);
    if !bound.invariants.is_empty()&&!known_failure{
        if selection.flags.contains_key("fixture"){
            match super::test_fixture::engine_at(project,bound,&selection,1_800_000_000_000){
                Ok(fixture)=>if bound.schema.tables.keys().any(|t|fixture.store().rows(t).is_ok_and(|rs|!rs.is_empty())){security::challenges::fixture_observers(bound,&fixture,&mut campaign)}else{
                    // An empty starter directory selects generation, just as
                    // no fixture does. Give the direct contradiction its turn
                    // before empty-start mutation permutations spend the cap.
                    report=security::analyze_with_campaign(bound,&mut campaign);
                    security::add_source_notes(&mut report,sources,bound);
                    security::challenges::generated_campaign(bound,&mut campaign,false)
                },
                Err(why)=>{campaign.unsupported.insert(format!("fixture reachability not covered: {why}"));}
            }
        }else{security::challenges::generated_campaign(bound,&mut campaign,false);}
    }
    let sites=report.invariants.iter().filter(|v|v.status==security::Status::Unproved&&!campaign.violations.iter().any(|c|c.invariant_site==v.invariant.site.to_string()&&c.reachability.is_reachable())).map(|v|v.invariant.site.to_string()).collect();
    let campaign=security::challenges::run_selected_after(bound,Some(&sites),campaign);
    security::challenges::apply(&mut report,&campaign);
    if let Some(record)=cached {security::challenges::apply(&mut report,&security::challenges::Campaign{violations:record.violations,..Default::default()});}
    report
}
pub fn audit(options:&Options)->i32{
    let project=project_or_exit();
    let sources=match project.sources(){Ok(s)=>s,Err(e)=>{eprintln!("audit: {e}");return 2;}};
    let bound=compiled_or_exit(snapback4_lang::compile(&sources),options.json);
    // Audit is a permission map plus bounded evidence; `test` owns full campaigns.
    let report=report(&project,&bound,&sources,options);
    let dispositions=match super::security_reviews::review(&project,&sources,&report.notes,None){Ok(d)=>d,Err(error)=>{eprintln!("audit: E_SECURITY_NOTES: {error}");return 2;}};
    if options.json {let mut value=serde_json::to_value(&report).unwrap();value["securityReviews"]=serde_json::to_value(&dispositions).unwrap();println!("{value}");}
    else {print!("{}",report.text_with_all(options.flags.contains_key("all")));super::security_reviews::print(&dispositions);}
    if report.refuted(){1}else{0}
}
pub(super) fn exposure(report:&Report){
    let broad=report.exposures.iter().filter(|e|e.effects.get("read").is_some_and(|r|r=="allow"||r.starts_with("public"))).count();
    eprintln!("security exposure: {} tables, {} conditional audiences, {broad} broadly readable tables; run snapback4 audit for exact role/column predicates",report.exposures.len(),report.roles.len());
}
pub(super) fn summary(report:&Report,verbose:bool){
    let proved=report.invariants.iter().filter(|v|v.status==security::Status::Proved).count();
    let failures=report.invariants.iter().filter(|v|v.status==security::Status::Refuted&&v.counterexample.as_ref().is_some_and(|c|c.reachability.is_reachable())).collect::<Vec<_>>();
    let refuted=report.invariants.iter().filter(|v|v.status==security::Status::Refuted).count();
    eprintln!("security: {proved} proved, {refuted} refuted, {} unproved ({} failing)",report.invariants.len()-proved-refuted,failures.len());
    for v in &failures {
        let c=v.counterexample.as_ref().unwrap();
        eprintln!("  FIX {}: {} via {} as {} ({}); tighten enforcement to the declared intent, then run snapback4 test",v.invariant.site,v.invariant.target_label(),c.operation,c.viewer,serde_json::to_value(&c.reachability).unwrap().as_str().unwrap());
    }
    let supplemental=report.invariants.iter().filter(|v|v.status==security::Status::Refuted&&v.counterexample.as_ref().is_some_and(|c|!c.reachability.is_reachable())).count();
    if supplemental>0 {eprintln!("  {supplemental} seed/synthetic observations (non-failing)");}
    if verbose {eprint!("{}",report.text_with_all(true));}
    else if !report.invariants.is_empty()||!report.campaign_coverage.is_empty(){eprintln!("  next: snapback4 test; {} coverage gaps (check --verbose/JSON keeps every reason)",report.campaign_coverage.len());}
    if !report.exposures.is_empty(){eprintln!("  review audiences and {} uncovered exposures: snapback4 audit",report.uncovered.len());}
}

/// A rule-changing preflight demands a current campaign, without pretending
/// finite tests or undeclared intent certify a deployment.
pub(super) fn release_loop(project:&Project,bound:&Bound,sources:&[(String,String)],prior:Option<&Bound>,options:&Options)->Result<Option<String>,String>{
    let changed=prior.is_none_or(|old|bound.schema.tables.iter().any(|(name,t)|old.schema.tables.get(name).is_none_or(|o|serde_json::to_value((&o.rules,&o.column_reads,&o.written_by)).ok()!=serde_json::to_value((&t.rules,&t.column_reads,&t.written_by)).ok()))||old.schema.tables.keys().any(|t|!bound.schema.tables.contains_key(t)));
    if !changed{return Ok(None);}
    // @ref LLP 3000.036.004#153-rule-changing-deployment-review — review is prominent, strictness is explicit and failure-origin aware.
    let report=report(project,bound,sources,options);
    let mut notice=String::from("SECURITY REVIEW — rules changed\n");
    for v in report.invariants.iter().filter(|v|v.status==security::Status::Refuted&&v.counterexample.as_ref().is_some_and(|c|c.reachability.is_reachable())){
        let c=v.counterexample.as_ref().unwrap();
        notice.push_str(&format!("  FIX {} {}: refuted via {} as {} ({:?}); repair enforcement to match intent, then run snapback4 test\n",v.invariant.site,v.invariant.target_label(),c.operation,c.viewer,c.reachability));
    }
    for v in report.invariants.iter().filter(|v|v.status!=security::Status::Proved&&!v.counterexample.as_ref().is_some_and(|c|c.reachability.is_reachable())){
        notice.push_str(&format!("  REVIEW {} {}: unproved — {}; run snapback4 audit for all paths; preserve spec intent\n",v.invariant.site,v.invariant.target_label(),v.reasons.first().map(String::as_str).unwrap_or("finite observations do not prove intent")));
    }
    for n in &report.notes{notice.push_str(&format!("  REVIEW {} {}: {}\n    {}\n",n.site,n.code,n.message,n.rewrite));}
    notice.push_str(&format!("  {}\n",release_notice(project,bound,sources,options)));
    notice.push_str(&format!("  {} independent invariants; {} coverage gaps; finite campaigns are not proof",bound.invariants.len(),report.campaign_coverage.len()));
    exposure(&report);eprintln!("{notice}");
    if options.flags.contains_key("strict")&&report.refuted(){return Err("E_SECURITY_REVIEW: --strict refuses reachable refuted security intent; repair the named rules and rerun snapback4 test before deploy".into());}
    Ok(Some(notice))
}
fn age(timestamp:Option<i64>,now:i64)->String{
    timestamp.map(|t|format!("at {t} ms since Unix epoch, age {}s",now.saturating_sub(t).max(0)/1000)).unwrap_or_else(||"time/age unknown (legacy record)".into())
}
fn release_notice(project:&Project,bound:&Bound,sources:&[(String,String)],options:&Options)->String{
    let selection=options.flags.get("schema").map(|s|format!(" --source {s:?}")).unwrap_or_default();
    let fixture=options.flags.get("fixture").map(|s|format!(" --fixture {s:?}")).unwrap_or_default();
    let now=snapback4_core::now_ms();
    let matching=record::matching(project,options,sources);
    let matches=matching.is_some();
    match matching.or_else(||record::latest(project)){
        Some(record)=>{
            let result=if !record.complete{"incomplete"}else if record.run_violations.unwrap_or(record.violations.len())>0{"FAILED"}else{"completed, no observed violation"};
            let current=if matches{"matches selected source/fixtures/CLI"}else{"STALE: source, fixtures or CLI differ; does not qualify selected release"};
            let next=if matches&&record.complete{"matching test campaign recorded (finite, not proof)".into()}else{format!("run `snapback4 test{selection}{fixture}` before deployment")};
            format!("last test: {result}, {}; {current}; {} retained reachable refutations, {} coverage gaps; last completed test {}; {next}",age(record.recorded_at,now),record.violations.len(),record.coverage_gaps,age(record.last_completed_at,now))
        },
        None=>format!("last test: NEVER RECORDED; run `snapback4 test{selection}{fixture}` before deployment; no matching completed campaign for this source, fixtures and CLI; {} independent invariants",bound.invariants.len()),
    }
}
//! Repairs lead; uncertainty stays visible without repeating every proof blocker.
// @ref LLP 3000.036.004#144-actions-precede-coverage-details — advice is separate from replayed failures.
use super::{Report, Status};

/// One consequence ordering shared by check and audit. Lower means more urgent.
pub fn note_priority(code: &str) -> u8 {
    match code {
        "N_RETAINED_ROLE_GRANT" | "N_OPTIONAL_UPLOAD_CREATE" => 0,
        "N_PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION" | "N_SELF_CLAIMED_RELATIONSHIP" => 1,
        "N_GRANT_OUTLIVES_ROLE" | "N_OPTIONAL_EVIDENCE" | "N_ROLE_WIDE_READ" |
        "N_BROAD_READ" | "N_CALLER_TIME" | "N_SWEEP_ONLY_DEADLINE" |
        "N_CREATION_REASON" | "N_CREATION_MONEY" | "N_CONSTANT_APPROVAL" |
        "N_TRANSITION_BYPASS" | "N_STALE_CREATION_CHECK" | "N_DURATION_BOUNDS" |
        "N_ROLE_WIDE_WRITE" => 2,
        "N_COLUMN_RESULT_EXPOSURE" | "N_INSERT_WRITE_INTENT" => 5,
        "N_INVARIANT_RESTATES_RULE" => 6,
        "N_SECURITY_INTENT" => 7,
        _ => 4,
    }
}

impl Report {
    /// Full structured evidence remains in the report; this is a human action list.
    pub fn action_text(&self, limit: usize) -> String {
        let failures = self.invariants.iter().filter(|v| v.status == Status::Refuted &&
            v.counterexample.as_ref().is_some_and(|c| c.reachability.is_reachable())).collect::<Vec<_>>();
        let mut notes = self.notes.iter().collect::<Vec<_>>();
        notes.sort_by_key(|n| (note_priority(&n.code), n.site.file.clone(), n.site.line, n.site.col, &n.code, &n.message));
        notes.dedup_by(|a,b| a.site == b.site && a.code == b.code && a.message == b.message);
        let mut out = format!("security actions: {} fix{}, {} review{}\n", failures.len(),
            if failures.len() == 1 { "" } else { "es" }, notes.len(), if notes.len() == 1 { "" } else { "s" });
        for v in &failures {
            let c = v.counterexample.as_ref().unwrap();
            out.push_str(&format!("  FIX {}: {} via {} as {} ({}); tighten enforcement to the declared intent, then run snapback4 test\n",
                v.invariant.site, v.invariant.target_label(), c.operation, c.viewer, serde_json::to_value(&c.reachability).unwrap().as_str().unwrap()));
        }
        let mut shown = 0;
        for note in notes.iter().enumerate().filter_map(|(i,n)|
            (i < limit || note_priority(&n.code) <= 2).then_some(*n)) {
            shown += 1;
            out.push_str(&format!("  REVIEW {} {}: {}\n    {}\n",note.site,note.code,note.message,note.rewrite));
        }
        if shown < notes.len() { out.push_str(&format!("  {} more reviews: snapback4 audit --all or check --verbose\n", notes.len()-shown)); }
        let proved = self.invariants.iter().filter(|v| v.status == Status::Proved).count();
        let refuted = self.invariants.iter().filter(|v|v.status==Status::Refuted).count();
        let unproved = self.invariants.len()-proved-refuted;
        out.push_str(&format!("security: {proved} proved, {refuted} refuted, {unproved} unproved ({} failing)\n", failures.len()));
        let supplemental = self.invariants.iter().filter(|v| v.status == Status::Refuted &&
            v.counterexample.as_ref().is_some_and(|c| !c.reachability.is_reachable())).count();
        if supplemental > 0 {out.push_str(&format!("  {supplemental} seed/synthetic observations are non-failing\n"));}
        if unproved > 0 || !self.campaign_coverage.is_empty() {
            out.push_str(&format!("  next: snapback4 test; {} coverage gaps (audit --all/JSON keeps every reason)\n",self.campaign_coverage.len()));
        }
        if self.invariants.is_empty() {out.push_str("  next: answer snapback/generated/security-invariants.q.draft from the spec; declare intent and run snapback4 test\n");}
        out
    }
}
        }
        if options.flags.contains_key("verbose") { for line in &field_authority { println!("  {line}"); } }
        if options.flags.contains_key("verbose") {
            // Verbose keeps every explanation, in the same consequence order as the summary.
            let mut ranked: Vec<&snapback4_lang::Diagnostic> = bound.notes.iter().collect();
            ranked.sort_by_key(|note| crate::note_rank::tier(&note.code));
            let ranked: Vec<snapback4_lang::Diagnostic> = ranked.into_iter().cloned().collect();
            for report in note_reports(&ranked, true) { println!("{}", present(&report)); }
        } else {
            // Notes are advisory: ranked and grouped after the ok line, repeats shortened (note_rank).
            let mut notes = reviewed.new.iter().chain(visible_security.iter().copied()).map(|note| {
                let compact = completeness_note(note);
                crate::note_rank::Note { site: note.site.to_string(), code: note.code.clone(), summary: present(&note_summary(note)),
                    form: compact.is_none().then(|| crate::note_rank::compiled_form(&note.code, &note.rewrite)).flatten().map(|(lead, code)| (lead, present(&code))), compact }
            })
                .chain(certificates.iter().flat_map(|certificate| &certificate.search).map(|search| crate::note_rank::Note { site: search.site.to_string(), code: search.code.to_string(), summary: present(search.summary), form: None, compact: None }))
                .collect::<Vec<_>>();
            notes.sort_by_key(|note|(crate::note_rank::summary_order(&note.code),crate::note_rank::site_order(&note.site),note.code.clone(),note.summary.clone()));
            let cap=5.max(notes.iter().filter(|n|snapback4_lang::security::note_priority(&n.code)<=2).count());
            let remaining=notes.len().saturating_sub(cap);notes.truncate(cap);
            if remaining>0 {println!("{remaining} more actionable notes in check --verbose/JSON");}
            for line in crate::note_rank::render(notes) { println!("{}", crate::presentation::abbreviate_quoted(&line)); }
        }
    }
    if !options.json {security_reviews::print(&dispositions);}
    if !options.json && (options.flags.contains_key("verbose") || options.flags.contains_key("cost")) {
        println!("{scale_summary}");
    }
    if !options.json && options.flags.contains_key("verbose") {
        for search in certificates.iter().flat_map(|certificate| &certificate.search) {
            println!("  {} at {}: {}; rewrite: {} (guide {})", search.code, search.site, search.message, search.rewrite, search.guide);
        }
    }
    if details && !options.json {
        // @ref LLP 3000.036#17.7 — with every table online only, "never predicts" is every mutation and needs no action: verbose keeps it.
        if options.flags.contains_key("verbose") || bound.schema.synced().next().is_some() { print_prediction(&bound, options.flags.contains_key("verbose")); }
        if !options.flags.contains_key("verbose") { println!("check --verbose for explanations, rewrites and execution details; why <op> for one operation"); }
    }
    if details && options.flags.contains_key("residency") && !options.json { println!("{}", present(&residency::facts(&bound))); }
    if !details && options.flags.contains_key("residency") && !options.json {
        for (name, fact) in bound.schema.operations.iter().filter(|(_, fact)| !fact.components.is_empty()) {
            println!("  {name}: components: {}", fact.components.iter().map(|component| component.field.as_str()).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(", "));
        }
    }
    if !options.json && let Some(report) = &acquisition { println!("{report}"); }
    if !options.json && options.flags.contains_key("residency") && acquisition.is_none() {
        println!("residency (measurements): not measured — no dev store; use check --residency --fixture <fixture-directory> --as <principal>");
    }
    if !options.json && (options.flags.contains_key("verbose") || options.flags.contains_key("cost")) { for m in &bound.schema.maintains { if let Some(k)=&m.row_key {
        println!("  view {}: key {}.{} = {}.{}; one value per {} row; source fanout <= {}; writer recount <= {} examined source rows within remaining meter, then pending/background chunks <= {}",m.target,m.source,k.source_key,k.table,k.member_key,k.table,k.fanout,snapback4_core::engine::row_views::WRITER_RECOUNT,snapback4_core::engine::row_views::RECOUNT_CHUNK);
        if let Some(range) = row_view_range(&bound.schema, m) {
            println!("    device range: {}; index {}; horizon {} by {}; {}; {}", range["predicate"].as_str().unwrap(), range["index"].as_str().unwrap(), range["horizon"]["last"], range["horizon"]["index"].as_str().unwrap(), range["selection"].as_str().unwrap(), range["fallback"].as_str().unwrap());
        }
    } } }
    if !options.json && (options.flags.contains_key("verbose") || options.flags.contains_key("cost")) && !options.flags.contains_key("residency") {
        for (name, fact) in bound.schema.operations.iter().filter(|(_, fact)| fact.held) {
            println!("{}", present(&snapback4_lang::bind::residency::operation_lines(name, fact)));
        }
    }
    if options.flags.contains_key("cost") {
        for program in &bound.programs {
            let report = cost_report(&bound, &program.program, options.json || options.flags.contains_key("verbose"));
            if options.json { eprintln!("{report}"); } else { println!("{report}"); }
        }
    }
    if !options.json { security::summary(&security,options.flags.contains_key("verbose")||options.flags.contains_key("all")); }
    // @ref LLP 3000.011.003.000#7.2 — init-first projects keep the todo starter's files; name them and the one command that fits them.
    if !options.json && let Some(report) = init::starter_leftovers(&project.root) { println!("{report}"); }
    if security_failed { 1 } else { 0 }
}

/// The structural cost class of a program: what `check --cost` prints
/// instead of a price (LLP 2000.000 §6).
fn cost_report(bound: &Bound, program: &ir::Program, canonical: bool) -> String {
    let certificate = bound.programs.iter().find(|p| p.program.name == program.name).map_or_else(
        || crate::scale::analyze(&bound.schema, program), |p| crate::scale::analyze_bound(&bound.schema, p));
// Execute exact guide sources through packed client/native packages, with no checkout binary fallback.
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {mkdtempSync, mkdirSync, writeFileSync, readFileSync, copyFileSync, rmSync} from 'node:fs';
import {tmpdir} from 'node:os';
import {join} from 'node:path';
import {pathToFileURL, fileURLToPath} from 'node:url';
import {command as runCommand} from '../dist/proof.js';
const root = fileURLToPath(new URL('../../../', import.meta.url));
const binary = process.env.SNAPBACK4_BIN || join(root, 'target/debug/snapback4');
const png = Buffer.from('89504e470d0a1a0a0000000d494844520000000100000001', 'hex');
// Keep live-host output and HTTP socket closure observable during CLI work.
const invoke = async (command, args, cwd, env = process.env) => {
  const out = await runCommand(command, args, {cwd, env, timeoutMs:120000});
  assert.equal(out.code, 0, `${command} ${args.join(' ')}\n${out.stdout}\n${out.stderr}`);
  return out.stdout;
};

//! Advice identifies a risk shape; it never supplies a proof assumption.
// @ref LLP 3000.036.004#123-actionable-authority-advice — current roles, grant writers, required evidence and refusal oracles.
use super::*;
use crate::ast::{Expr,Stmt,ProgramKind};
const NOW_FOR_DEFAULTS:i64=1_800_000_000_000;
fn rule_parts(rule:&RuleExpr)->Vec<&RuleExpr>{match rule{RuleExpr::And(xs)|RuleExpr::Or(xs)=>xs.iter().flat_map(rule_parts).collect(),RuleExpr::Not(x)=>rule_parts(x),r=>vec![r]}}
fn role_test(bound:&Bound,rule:&RuleExpr)->bool {rule_parts(rule).iter().any(|r|match r{
    RuleExpr::Exists{table,index,key,equalities,..} if key.iter().chain(equalities.iter().map(|(_,v)|v)).any(|t|matches!(t,RuleTerm::Viewer))=>{
        if super::privilege::membership_probe(bound,r,table){return true;}
        let columns=super::privilege::role_columns(bound,table);
        super::privilege::probe_pairs(bound,table,index,key,equalities).iter().any(|(c,t)|columns.contains(c)&&matches!(t,RuleTerm::Literal(_)))
    },_=>false,
})}
fn reader_columns(rule:&RuleExpr)->BTreeSet<String>{rule_parts(rule).into_iter().filter_map(|r|match r{RuleExpr::Eq(RuleTerm::Field(f),RuleTerm::Viewer)|RuleExpr::Eq(RuleTerm::Viewer,RuleTerm::Field(f))=>Some(f.clone()),_=>None}).collect()}
fn note(notes:&mut Vec<Diagnostic>,site:&Site,code:&str,message:String,rewrite:&str){notes.push(Diagnostic::new(site,code,message,rewrite).guide("security"));}
pub(super) fn mutable_role(bound:&Bound,name:&str)->bool {
    let Some(t)=bound.schema.table(name)else{return false;};
    let mut roles=super::privilege::role_columns(bound,name);
    if roles.is_empty()&&let Some(principal)=super::privilege::global_principal(bound,name){roles.insert(principal);}
    if roles.is_empty(){return false;}
    let mutable=roles.iter().any(|c|!t.constraints.iter().any(|k|matches!(k,snapback4_core::schema::Constraint::Immutable{fields} if fields.contains(c))));
    fn supplied(value:&serde_json::Value,roles:&BTreeSet<String>)->bool{
        if let Some(fields)=value.get("Object").and_then(serde_json::Value::as_object){return fields.keys().any(|c|roles.contains(c));}
        if let Some(fields)=value.get("Literal").and_then(|v|v.get("Map").or_else(||v.get("Row"))).and_then(serde_json::Value::as_object){return fields.keys().any(|c|roles.contains(c));}
        true // Dynamic patches cannot establish that role fields are untouched.
    }
    fn writes(value:&serde_json::Value,name:&str,roles:&BTreeSet<String>,update:bool,delete:bool)->bool{
        match value{
            serde_json::Value::Object(xs)=>{
                for tag in ["Update","Upsert","WriteTarget"]{if let Some(body)=xs.get(tag){
                    let target=if tag=="WriteTarget"{body.get("target").and_then(|v|v.get("table"))}else{body.get("table")};
                    if update&&target.and_then(serde_json::Value::as_str)==Some(name)&&body.get(if tag=="Upsert"{"row"}else{"patch"}).is_some_and(|v|supplied(v,roles)){return true;}
                }}
                for tag in ["Delete","DeleteTarget"]{if let Some(body)=xs.get(tag){
                    let target=if tag=="DeleteTarget"{body.get("target").and_then(|v|v.get("table"))}else{body.get("table")};
                    if delete&&target.and_then(serde_json::Value::as_str)==Some(name){return true;}
                }}
                xs.values().any(|v|writes(v,name,roles,update,delete))
            },serde_json::Value::Array(xs)=>xs.iter().any(|v|writes(v,name,roles,update,delete)),_=>false,
        }
    }
    bound.programs.iter().any(|p|{
        let system=p.program.kind==snapback4_core::ir::ProgramKind::Job;
        let update=mutable&&(system||!matches!(t.rules.update,RuleExpr::Deny)||roles.iter().any(|c|t.written_by.contains_key(c)));
        let delete=system||!matches!(t.rules.delete,RuleExpr::Deny);
        writes(&serde_json::to_value(&p.program).unwrap(),name,&roles,update,delete)
    })
}
fn recipient_role(bound:&Bound,name:&str,branch:&RuleExpr,grant:Option<&str>,roster:&str,effect:&str)->bool{
    if bound.invariants.iter().any(|i|i.table==*name&&(i.target==effect||i.target=="write"&&matches!(effect,"insert"|"update"))&&i.policy.as_ref().is_some_and(|p|kernel::dependencies(p).contains(roster)&&role_test(bound,p)&&kernel::implies(branch,p)!=Ok(true))){return true;}
    // This is conditional lifetime advice, not an inferred current-role
    // contract: the retained grant does not itself consult this mutable roster.
    grant.is_some()&&!kernel::dependencies(branch).contains(roster)
}
pub(super) fn notes(bound:&Bound,exposures:&[Exposure])->Vec<Diagnostic>{
    let mut notes=Vec::new();
    // @ref LLP 3000.036.004#131-intent-and-diagnostics — equivalence is advice, never refusal.
    for inv in &bound.invariants {
        if inv.operation.is_some()||inv.target=="always" {continue;}
        let Some(policy)=&inv.policy else{continue;};
        let table=&bound.schema.tables[&inv.table];
        let mut admissions=Vec::new();
        let restates=super::effects(inv).iter().all(|word|{
            if matches!(*word,"insert"|"update")&&!table.written_by.is_empty(){return false;}
            let gate=if *word=="read"{super::columns::admission(table,inv.column.as_deref())}else if *word=="update"{super::images::stable(table,&table.update_rule_judged())}else{table.rules.for_effect(super::effect(word)).clone()};
            let intent=if *word=="update"{super::images::stable(table,&policy.old_and_next())}else{policy.clone()};
            let matches=super::intent::restates(bound,&inv.table,word,&gate,&intent);
            admissions.push((word.to_string(),gate));
            matches
        });
        if restates {
            let target=inv.column.as_ref().map(|c|format!("{}.{c}",inv.table)).unwrap_or(inv.table.clone());
            let questions=admissions.iter().map(|(word,gate)|super::intent::questions(bound,&target,word,gate)).collect::<Vec<_>>();
            note(&mut notes,&inv.site,"N_INVARIANT_RESTATES_RULE",format!("{} matches or weakens current enforcement. {}",inv.target_label(),questions.join(" ")),"answer each audience question from the app specification; keep confirmed intent, and narrow unintended access in the rule. Review the per-role/per-column questionnaire in snapback/generated/security-invariants.q.draft; run check -> test -> audit");}
    }

    for (name,t) in bound.schema.visible_tables(){
        notes.extend(super::advice::read_notes(bound,name,t));
        for (column,kind) in &t.columns {
            use snapback4_core::schema::ColumnType as C;
            if kind.contains_asset() && (kind.is_optional() || matches!(kind.required(),C::List{..}|C::ListRange{min:0,..})) {
                note(&mut notes,&Site::default(),"N_OPTIONAL_EVIDENCE",format!("{name}.{column} permits omitted or empty media evidence"),"if the spec requires evidence, declare a required image/file or [image] 1..N; otherwise retain optionality deliberately (guide security)");
            }
        }
        for leaf in rule_parts(&t.rules.insert) {
            if let RuleExpr::Created {table:parent,..}=leaf
                && bound.schema.table(parent).is_some_and(|p| p.rules.insert.disjuncts().iter().any(|r| matches!(r,RuleExpr::Allow|RuleExpr::Eq(RuleTerm::Field(_),RuleTerm::Viewer)|RuleExpr::Eq(RuleTerm::Viewer,RuleTerm::Field(_)))))
                && bound.schema.tables.values().any(|other| super::columns::rules(other).any(|r| rule_parts(r).iter().any(|r|matches!(r,RuleExpr::Exists{table,key,equalities,..} if table==name&&matches!(key.as_slice(),[RuleTerm::Viewer])&&equalities.is_empty())))) {
                note(&mut notes,&Site::default(),"N_VACUOUS_RULE",format!("{name}: `created {parent}` can bootstrap authority trusted globally by a viewer-only probe; a caller may create their own global administrator grant"),"provision global authority only through an operator/service seat or existing authorized admin; group creation must scope every later grant to that group (guide deploy, first-admin setup)");
            }
        }
        for (label,rule) in super::columns::effects(t) {
          let (effect,_column)=label.strip_suffix(" read").map(|column|("read",Some(column))).unwrap_or((label.as_str(),None));
          for branch in rule.disjuncts(){
            for dep in kernel::dependencies(branch){if let Some(g)=bound.schema.table(&dep) {
                let rosters=[&g.rules.insert,&g.rules.update].into_iter().flat_map(kernel::dependencies).filter(|r|r!=&dep&&mutable_role(bound,r)).collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
                if rosters.iter().any(|r|recipient_role(bound,name,branch,Some(&dep),r,effect))&&(role_test(bound,&g.rules.insert)||role_test(bound,&g.rules.update)){
                    note(&mut notes,&Site::default(),"N_GRANT_OUTLIVES_ROLE",format!("{name}.{label}: `{}` trusts retained {dep} grants that can survive role changes in {}; confirm whether current-role intent is required",branch.quarry(),rosters.into_iter().collect::<Vec<_>>().join(", ")),"recheck the current role in this branch or revoke every derived grant transactionally on role changes; guide security");
                }
            }}
            // A principal's own row does not imply revocable role-grant
            // intent. Retained assignment probes above remain reviewable.

          }
        }
    }
    // Inspect original syntax for argument flow and distinct authored codes.
    // Keeping lints outside Bound.notes preserves the compiler's existing
    // diagnostic contract; check/audit expose this security advice separately.
    let _=exposures;
    let mut retained=BTreeSet::new();
    notes.retain(|n|n.code!="N_GRANT_OUTLIVES_ROLE"||retained.insert(n.message.split(':').next().unwrap_or("").to_string()));
    notes
}
