//! Real operation histories from a complete trusted fixture, including assets.
// @ref LLP 3000.036.004#122-reproducible-campaigns-and-reachability — only actual fixture traces establish application reachability.
use super::*;
const LIMIT:usize=512;
#[derive(Clone,Debug,Serialize,serde::Deserialize)]
pub struct Step {pub operation:String,pub viewer:String,pub args:BTreeMap<String,Value>,pub result:serde_json::Value}

pub(super) fn viewers(bound:&Bound)->Vec<String>{
    let mut out=BTreeSet::from([VIEWER.into(),OTHER.into(),"account:security-no-role".into(),"service:security".into()]);
    out.extend(bound.personas.iter().map(|p|if p.contains(':'){p.clone()}else{format!("dev:{p}")}));
    fn seats(value:&serde_json::Value,out:&mut BTreeSet<String>){match value{
        serde_json::Value::String(s) if s.starts_with("service:")&&s.len()>8=>{out.insert(s.clone());},
        serde_json::Value::Array(xs)=>for x in xs{seats(x,out)},
        serde_json::Value::Object(xs)=>for x in xs.values(){seats(x,out)},_=>{}
    }}
    seats(&serde_json::to_value(&bound.schema).unwrap(),&mut out);
    for p in &bound.programs{seats(&serde_json::to_value(&p.program).unwrap(),&mut out);}
    seats(&serde_json::to_value(&bound.invariants).unwrap(),&mut out);
    out.into_iter().collect()
}
pub(super) fn actors(bound:&Bound,rows:&BTreeMap<String,Vec<Value>>)->Vec<String>{
    let mut out=viewers(bound);
    for (table,rs) in rows{for row in rs{for (c,k) in &bound.schema.tables[table].columns{
        if matches!(k.required(),C::Principal)&&let Ok(Value::Id(p))=row.field(c)&&!out.contains(p){out.push(p.clone());}
    }}}
    out
}
pub(super) fn fixture_cases(bound:&Bound,p:&Program,rows:&BTreeMap<String,Vec<Value>>,actors:&[String],out:&mut Campaign)->Vec<BTreeMap<String,Value>>{
    let args=&p.args;
    let mut literals=BTreeMap::<String,Vec<Value>>::new();
    fn collect(value:&serde_json::Value,out:&mut BTreeMap<String,Vec<Value>>){
        if let Some(binary)=value.get("Binary") {for (a,b) in [("left","right"),("right","left")] {
            if let (Some(name),Some(literal))=(binary.get(a).and_then(|v|v.get("Variable")).and_then(serde_json::Value::as_str),binary.get(b).and_then(|v|v.get("Literal"))) {
                if let Ok(value)=serde_json::from_value::<Value>(literal.clone()){out.entry(name.into()).or_default().push(value);}
            }
        }}
        match value{serde_json::Value::Object(xs)=>for v in xs.values(){collect(v,out)},serde_json::Value::Array(xs)=>for v in xs{collect(v,out)},_=>{}}
    }
    collect(&serde_json::to_value(p).unwrap(),&mut literals);
    fn values(name:&str,k:&ir::ArgType,rows:&BTreeMap<String,Vec<Value>>,actors:&[String])->Option<Vec<Value>>{
        Some(match k{
            ir::ArgType::Enum{variants}=>variants.iter().map(|s|Value::String(s.clone())).collect(),
            ir::ArgType::Text{min,max,..}=>['z','y'].into_iter().map(|c|Value::String(c.to_string().repeat((*min).max(1).min(*max) as usize))).collect(),
            ir::ArgType::Int=>vec![Value::Int(0),Value::Int(1),Value::Int(2)],
            ir::ArgType::IntRange{min,max}=>{let mut xs=vec![*min,1i64.clamp(*min,*max),*max];xs.sort();xs.dedup();xs.into_iter().map(Value::Int).collect()},
            ir::ArgType::Bool=>vec![Value::Bool(false),Value::Bool(true)],
            ir::ArgType::Time=>vec![Value::Int(NOW-86_400_000),Value::Int(NOW),Value::Int(NOW+86_400_000)],
            ir::ArgType::Principal=>actors.iter().map(|s|Value::Id(s.clone())).collect(),
            ir::ArgType::Ref{table} if rows.get(table).is_some_and(|rs|!rs.is_empty())=>rows[table].iter().filter_map(|r|r.field("id").ok().cloned()).collect(),
            ir::ArgType::Optional(inner)=>{let mut v=vec![Value::Null];v.extend(values(name,inner,rows,actors)?);v},
            _=>vec![arguments(&BTreeMap::from([(name.into(),k.clone())]),0)?.remove(name)?],
        })
    }
    let mut cases=vec![BTreeMap::new()];
    for (name,k) in args{
        let Some(mut vals)=values(name,k,rows,actors)else{out.unsupported.insert(format!("{name}: history needs a typed asset argument"));return Vec::new();};
        for literal in literals.get(name).into_iter().flatten() {
            let valid=match (k,literal){
                (ir::ArgType::Text{min,max,..},Value::String(s))=>s.chars().filter(|c|!c.is_whitespace()).count()>=*min as usize&&s.chars().count()<=*max as usize,
                (ir::ArgType::Int,Value::Int(_))=>true,
                (ir::ArgType::IntRange{min,max},Value::Int(n))=>(*min..=*max).contains(n),_=>false,
            };
            if valid&&!vals.contains(literal){vals.insert(0,literal.clone());}
        }
        let mut next=Vec::new();
        'product:for offset in 0..vals.len(){for n in 0..cases.len().max(vals.len()){
            if out.exhausted(){return next;}
            let mut case=cases[n%cases.len()].clone();case.insert(name.clone(),vals[(n+offset)%vals.len()].clone());
            if !next.contains(&case){next.push(case);}if next.len()==LIMIT{out.unsupported.insert("history arguments capped at 512 combinations".into());break 'product;}
        }}
        cases=next;
    }
    let focused=super::executed::write_arguments(bound,p).into_iter().filter(|a|matches!(p.args.get(a),Some(ir::ArgType::Optional(_)))).collect::<Vec<_>>();
    if focused.is_empty(){return cases;}
    let mut prioritized=Vec::new();
    for case in cases{
        if !prioritized.contains(&case){prioritized.push(case.clone());}
        for name in &focused{if let Some(value)=arguments(&BTreeMap::from([(name.clone(),p.args[name].clone())]),4).and_then(|mut a|a.remove(name))&&value!=Value::Null{
            let mut alternate=case.clone();alternate.insert(name.clone(),value);if !prioritized.contains(&alternate){prioritized.push(alternate);}
        }}
        if prioritized.len()>=LIMIT{prioritized.truncate(LIMIT);out.unsupported.insert("column-write argument frontier capped at 512; remaining combinations uncovered".into());break;}
    }prioritized
}
// Preserve status/decision alternatives on each resource tuple before the
// small directed cap; text/noise arguments must not correlate bools with ids.
fn directed_cases(p:&Program,cases:Vec<BTreeMap<String,Value>>)->Vec<BTreeMap<String,Value>>{
    let identities=p.args.iter().filter(|(_,k)|matches!(k,ir::ArgType::Ref{..}|ir::ArgType::Principal)).map(|(n,_)|n).collect::<Vec<_>>();
    let mut seen=BTreeSet::new();let mut groups=Vec::new();
    for base in cases{let key=serde_json::to_string(&identities.iter().map(|n|(*n,base.get(*n))).collect::<Vec<_>>()).unwrap();if !seen.insert(key){continue;}
        let mut group=vec![base.clone()];
        for (name,kind) in &p.args{let values=match kind{ir::ArgType::Bool=>vec![Value::Bool(false),Value::Bool(true)],ir::ArgType::Enum{variants}=>variants.iter().cloned().map(Value::String).collect(),_=>Vec::new()};
            for value in values{let mut candidate=base.clone();candidate.insert(name.clone(),value);if !group.contains(&candidate){group.push(candidate);}}
        }groups.push(group);
    }
    let mut out=Vec::new();for n in 0..groups.iter().map(Vec::len).max().unwrap_or(0){for group in &groups{if let Some(args)=group.get(n){out.push(args.clone());}}}out
}
pub(super) fn trace_key(steps:&[Step])->Vec<(&str,&str)>{steps.iter().map(|s|(s.operation.as_str(),s.viewer.as_str())).collect()}
pub(super) fn violation(out:&mut Campaign,inv:&Invariant,steps:&[Step],viewer:&str,row:&Value,old:Option<&Value>,initial:&BTreeMap<String,Vec<Value>>,effect:&str)->bool{
    if out.violations.iter().any(|v|v.invariant_site==inv.site.to_string()&&v.viewer==viewer&&v.reachability==Reachability::AuthoredFixtureTrace&&trace_key(&v.history)==trace_key(steps)){return false;}
    out.violations.push(Counterexample{reachability:Reachability::AuthoredFixtureTrace,observations:None,history:steps.to_vec(),invariant_site:inv.site.to_string(),args:BTreeMap::new(),viewer:viewer.into(),operation:steps.last().map(|s|s.operation.clone()).unwrap_or("$fixture.read".into()),effect:effect.into(),row:row.clone(),old:old.cloned(),supporting_rows:initial.clone(),rule_path:"actual authored operation/read from the trusted fixture".into(),scope:"reachable from recorded trusted fixture; finite trace, not an all-history proof".into()});true
}
pub(super) fn typed_disclosure(ty:&crate::types::Ty,data:&Value,table:&str,key:&Value,column:Option<&str>,physical:&Value)->bool{
    typed_disclosure_image(ty,data,table,key,column,physical,None)
}
pub(super) fn typed_disclosure_image(ty:&crate::types::Ty,data:&Value,table:&str,key:&Value,column:Option<&str>,physical:&Value,policy:Option<&RuleExpr>)->bool{
    use crate::types::Ty;
    let payload=|data:&Value|matches!(data,Value::Row(_))&&data.field("id").ok()==Some(key)&&column.is_none_or(|c|data.field(c).ok().is_some_and(|v|physical.field(c).ok()==Some(v)))&&policy.is_none_or(|p|!p.any_term(&|term|{
        let column=match term{RuleTerm::Field(c)|RuleTerm::OldField(c)|RuleTerm::NextField(c)=>Some(c.as_str()),RuleTerm::Reference{column,..}|RuleTerm::ReferenceChain{column,..}=>Some(column.as_str()),_=>None};
        column.filter(|c|*c!="$security:server-clock").is_some_and(|c|data.field(c).is_err()||data.field(c).ok()!=physical.field(c).ok())
    }));
    match ty{
        Ty::Row(t)|Ty::WriteRow(t) if t==table=>payload(data),
        Ty::Optional(inner)|Ty::Omittable(inner)=>typed_disclosure_image(inner,data,table,key,column,physical,policy),
        Ty::Page(t,_) if t==table=>matches!(data,Value::Array(xs) if xs.iter().any(payload)),
        Ty::List(inner,_)|Ty::Collection(inner,_)=>matches!(data,Value::Array(xs) if xs.iter().any(|r|typed_disclosure_image(inner,r,table,key,column,physical,policy))),
        Ty::Object(fields)|Ty::RowShape(fields)|Ty::RowObject(fields)=>fields.iter().any(|(name,ty)|data.field(name).ok().is_some_and(|v|typed_disclosure_image(ty,v,table,key,column,physical,policy))),
        _=>false,
    }
}
pub(super) fn typed_source(ty:&crate::types::Ty,table:&str)->bool{
    use crate::types::Ty;
    match ty{Ty::Row(t)|Ty::WriteRow(t)|Ty::Page(t,_)=>t==table,Ty::Optional(inner)|Ty::Omittable(inner)|Ty::List(inner,_)|Ty::Collection(inner,_)=>typed_source(inner,table),Ty::Object(fields)|Ty::RowShape(fields)|Ty::RowObject(fields)=>fields.values().any(|ty|typed_source(ty,table)),_=>false}
}
pub(super) fn observer_tables(bound:&Bound,table:&str)->BTreeSet<String>{
    let mut out=BTreeSet::from([table.into()]);
    loop{let before=out.len();
        for m in &bound.schema.maintains{if out.contains(&m.source){out.insert(m.target.clone());if let Some(owner)=&m.private{out.insert(owner.table.clone());}}}
        for (name,t) in &bound.schema.tables{if t.through.as_ref().is_some_and(|edge|out.contains(&edge.parent))||super::super::columns::rules(t).any(|r|kernel::dependencies(r).iter().any(|t|out.contains(t))){out.insert(name.clone());}}
        if out.len()==before{return out;}
    }
}
fn reserve_observers(out:&mut Campaign,calls:usize)->bool{
    if !out.reserve(calls){return false;}
    if out.history_observer_calls+calls>32768{out.unsupported.insert("history read observers capped at 32768 calls; remaining disclosure combinations not covered".into());false}else{out.history_observer_calls+=calls;true}
}
    let Ok(initial)=readback(fixture)else{return;};
    let actors=actors(bound,&initial);
    if !out.reserve(1){return;}
    let Ok(mut engine)=fork(bound,fixture,Vec::new())else{return;};
    observe(bound,&mut engine,&initial,&initial,&actors,&[],out);
}
// Prefer real lifecycle successors before the general diagonal history matrix.
// @ref LLP 3000.036.004#163-directed-finite-histories — pruning orders finite replay, never proves safety.
pub(super) fn lifecycle_observers(bound:&Bound,fixture:&Engine,out:&mut Campaign){
    if bound.invariants.is_empty()||out.exhausted()||bound.invariants.iter().all(|i|out.violations.iter().any(|v|v.invariant_site==i.site.to_string()&&v.reachability.is_reachable())){return;}
    let interesting=bound.invariants.iter().filter(|i|{
        if out.violations.iter().any(|v|v.invariant_site==i.site.to_string()&&v.reachability.is_reachable()){return false;}
        let t=&bound.schema.tables[&i.table];let gate=match i.target.as_str(){"read"=>super::super::columns::admission(t,i.column.as_deref()),"insert"=>t.rules.insert.clone(),"update"=>t.update_rule_judged().into_owned(),_=>RuleExpr::Allow};
        i.policy.as_ref().is_none_or(|policy|kernel::implies(&gate,policy)!=Ok(true))
    }).collect::<Vec<_>>();
    if interesting.is_empty(){return;}
    let selected_sites=interesting.iter().map(|i|i.site.to_string()).collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
    let mut relevant=interesting.into_iter().flat_map(|i|std::iter::once(i.table.clone()).chain(i.policy.iter().flat_map(kernel::dependencies))).collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
    for _ in 0..bound.schema.tables.len(){let old=relevant.clone();for name in &old{for kind in bound.schema.tables[name].columns.values(){if let C::Ref{table}=kind.required(){relevant.insert(table.clone());}}}if old==relevant{break;}}
    let has_lifecycle=relevant.iter().any(|name|bound.schema.tables[name].columns.values().any(|k|matches!(k.required(),C::Enum{..}|C::Bool|C::Principal|C::Ref{..})));
    if !has_lifecycle{return;}
    let transitions=bound.programs.iter().filter(|bp|bp.program.kind==ProgramKind::Mutation&&!bp.program.native&&!bound.schema.operations.get(&bp.program.name).is_some_and(|f|f.ephemeral)).filter(|bp|{
        ir::write_tables(&bp.program).iter().any(|(name,kind)|relevant.contains(name)&&(*kind!="insert"||bound.invariants.iter().any(|i|&i.table==name)))
    }).collect::<Vec<_>>();
    if transitions.is_empty(){return;}
    let Ok(initial)=readback(fixture)else{return;};
    if !relevant.iter().any(|name|super::super::privilege::role_columns(bound,name).is_empty()&&initial.get(name).is_some_and(|rs|!rs.is_empty())){
        out.unsupported.insert("directed lifecycle needs a populated resource root; generated initialization and breadth retain bootstraps, longer empty-start histories remain uncovered".into());return;
    }
    let actors=actors(bound,&initial);
    if !out.reserve(1){return;}
    let Ok(root)=fixture.fork_fixture()else{return;};
    let mut frontier=vec![(root,Vec::<Step>::new())];
    fn signature(bound:&Bound,rows:&BTreeMap<String,Vec<Value>>)->String{
        // Equality of this projection is only an exploration heuristic. Missing
        // worlds are explicitly uncovered; it never discharges an obligation.
        let projected=rows.iter().map(|(name,rs)|{let t=&bound.schema.tables[name];let mut images=rs.iter().map(|r|t.columns.iter().filter(|(c,k)|c.as_str()!="id"&&matches!(k.required(),C::Enum{..}|C::Bool|C::Principal|C::Ref{..})).filter_map(|(c,_)|r.field(c).ok().map(|v|(c.clone(),v.clone()))).collect::<BTreeMap<_,_>>()).collect::<Vec<_>>();images.sort_by_key(|r|serde_json::to_string(r).unwrap());(name.clone(),images)}).collect::<BTreeMap<_,_>>();serde_json::to_string(&projected).unwrap()
    }
    let mut seen=BTreeSet::from([signature(bound,&initial)]);
    for _ in 0..8{
        let mut next=Vec::new();let frontier_count=frontier.len();
        for (base,steps) in frontier{
            let Ok(before)=readback(&base)else{continue;};
            for bp in &transitions{
                let p=&bp.program;
                let targets=ir::write_tables(p);

                if targets.iter().all(|(t,kind)|*kind=="insert"&&before.get(t).is_some_and(|rs|rs.len()>=2)){out.unsupported.insert("directed lifecycle omits further insert-only expansion of populated tables; additional populations uncovered".into());continue;}
                let ordinary=fixture_cases(bound,p,&before,&actors,out);
                let mut cases=role_candidates(bound,p,&before,&actors,&ordinary,&base,out).into_iter().map(|(_,_,args)|args).collect::<Vec<_>>();
                cases.extend(ordinary);let mut argument_keys=BTreeSet::new();cases.retain(|args|argument_keys.insert(serde_json::to_string(args).unwrap()));
                let cases=directed_cases(p,cases);
                if cases.len()>4{out.unsupported.insert(format!("{}: directed lifecycle arguments capped at 4",p.name));}
                let mut successors=Vec::<(Engine,Vec<Step>,usize,String)>::new();
                let program_json=serde_json::to_string(p).unwrap();
                for args in cases.into_iter().take(4){
                    let mut ordered=actors.iter().map(|actor|{
                        let mut score=0;let mut class=BTreeSet::new();
                        for (table,rs) in &before{let roles=super::super::privilege::role_columns(bound,table);for row in rs{
                            if !bound.schema.tables[table].columns.iter().any(|(c,k)|matches!(k.required(),C::Principal)&&row.field(c).ok()==Some(&Value::Id(actor.clone()))){continue;}
                            for c in &roles{if let Ok(value)=row.field(c){class.insert(format!("{table}.{c}={value:?}"));}}
                            if !roles.is_empty()&&roles.iter().any(|c|row.field(c).is_ok_and(|v|matches!(v,Value::String(role) if program_json.contains(&format!("\"String\":\"{role}\""))))){score+=4;}
                            if p.args.iter().any(|(name,k)|matches!(k,ir::ArgType::Ref{table:t} if t==table)&&args.get(name)==row.field("id").ok()){score+=2;class.insert(format!("owns target {table}"));}
                        }}
                        if program_json.contains(&format!("\"{}\"",actor)){score+=8;}
                        (actor,score,class)
                    }).collect::<Vec<_>>();ordered.sort_by_key(|(_,score,_)|std::cmp::Reverse(*score));
                    // Two principals of one privileged role must not consume
                    // both slots and hide a different admitted role's witness.
                    let mut actor_classes=BTreeSet::new();ordered.retain(|(_,_,class)|actor_classes.insert(class.clone()));
                    if ordered.len()>2{out.unsupported.insert(format!("{}: directed actor ordering keeps two candidates per argument tuple; other actors remain in breadth campaign",p.name));}
                    for (viewer,_,_) in ordered.into_iter().take(2){
                    if out.directed_attempts>=2048||!out.reserve(1){out.unsupported.insert("directed lifecycle successors capped at 2048 attempts/shared campaign budget; remaining histories uncovered".into());return;}out.directed_attempts+=1;
                    let Ok(mut engine)=base.fork_fixture()else{continue;};
                    let Ok(args)=materialize_arguments(&mut engine,&p.args,&args,viewer)else{continue;};
                    let mut prior=None;
                    if bound.invariants.iter().any(|i|i.target!="read"&&i.policy.as_ref().is_some_and(RuleExpr::has_reference)){if !out.reserve(1){return;}prior=base.fork_fixture().ok();}
                    out.attempted+=1;*out.operations.entry(p.name.clone()).or_default()+=1;
                    let trace=super::executed::trace(bound,p);
                    let Ok(result)=engine.mutate(&p.name,None,Context::new(viewer,args.clone()).at(NOW).with_fixture_trace(trace.clone()))else{continue;};
                    if !matches!(result.state,snapback4_core::WriteState::Sent{..}){out.refused+=1;continue;}
                    let Ok(after)=readback(&engine)else{continue;};
                    let mut history=steps.clone();history.push(Step{operation:p.name.clone(),viewer:viewer.clone(),args:args.clone(),result:serde_json::to_value(&result.state).unwrap()});
                    super::executed::record(bound,p,&trace,&result.state,&after,&initial,viewer,&history,&mut engine,out);
                    changed(bound,p,&before,&after,&initial,viewer,&history,&mut prior,&mut engine,out);
                    if selected_sites.iter().all(|site|out.violations.iter().any(|v|&v.invariant_site==site&&v.reachability.is_reachable())){
                        out.unsupported.insert("directed lifecycle stopped after every selected independent intent had a replayed violation; additional histories uncovered".into());return;
                    }
                    if before==after{continue;}
                    out.sequences+=1;
                    if !seen.insert(signature(bound,&after)){out.unsupported.insert("directed lifecycle signature merges worlds differing in non-status payload; remaining worlds uncovered".into());continue;}
                    observe(bound,&mut engine,&after,&initial,&actors,&history,out);
                    column_reads::after_history(bound,&engine,&initial,&history,out);
                    if selected_sites.iter().all(|site|out.violations.iter().any(|v|&v.invariant_site==site&&v.reachability.is_reachable())){
                        out.unsupported.insert("directed lifecycle stopped after every selected independent intent had a replayed violation; additional histories uncovered".into());return;
                    }
                    let progress=after.iter().filter(|(name,_)|relevant.contains(*name)).map(|(name,rs)|{let t=&bound.schema.tables[name];rs.iter().map(|r|t.columns.iter().map(|(c,k)|match k.required(){C::Enum{..} if !super::super::privilege::role_columns(bound,name).contains(c)=>before.get(name).into_iter().flatten().find(|old|old.field("id").ok()==r.field("id").ok()).is_some_and(|old|old.field(c).ok()!=r.field(c).ok()) as usize*4,C::Bool=>matches!(r.field(c),Ok(Value::Bool(true))) as usize,_=>0}).sum::<usize>()).sum::<usize>()}).sum::<usize>();
                    let state_key=signature(bound,&after.iter().filter(|(name,_)|relevant.contains(*name)).map(|(name,rs)|(name.clone(),rs.clone())).collect());
                    if successors.iter().any(|(_,_,_,key)|key==&state_key){out.unsupported.insert("directed successor diversity merges audit-only attribution variants; additional histories uncovered".into());continue;}
                    successors.push((engine,history,progress,state_key));
                    out.directed_peak_worlds=out.directed_peak_worlds.max(frontier_count+next.len()+successors.len()+1);
                    successors.sort_by_key(|(_,_,priority,_)|std::cmp::Reverse(*priority));
                    if successors.len()>2{successors.truncate(2);out.unsupported.insert(format!("{}: directed successor selection keeps two priority resource states per operation/world; other states uncovered",p.name));}
                }}
                for (engine,history,priority,_) in successors{
                    next.push((engine,history,priority));
                    out.directed_peak_worlds=out.directed_peak_worlds.max(frontier_count+next.len()+1);
                    next.sort_by_key(|(_,_,priority)|std::cmp::Reverse(*priority));
                    if next.len()>4{next.truncate(4);out.unsupported.insert("directed lifecycle beam keeps four priority worlds; displaced worlds dropped immediately and remain uncovered".into());}
                }
            }
        }
        if next.is_empty(){return;}
        frontier=next.into_iter().map(|(e,h,_)|(e,h)).collect();
    }
    out.unsupported.insert("directed lifecycle traces bounded to eight authored mutations; longer traces uncovered".into());
}

    let initial=match readback(fixture){Ok(r)=>r,Err(e)=>{out.unsupported.insert(e);return;}};

    fn write_inner(&mut self, expr: &A, out: &mut setup::Body, valued: bool) -> Fallible<Option<(Expr, Ty)>> {
        if self.viewer_depth.is_some() { return Err(job_reads::read_only(expr.site())); }
        let A::Write { op, table, keys, fields, if_absent, condition, site } = expr else { unreachable!() };
        // @ref LLP 3000.036#12 — `delete row` and `update row { … }` write the
        // row a present row variable holds: the same write as `t[row]`.
        if keys.is_empty() && matches!(op, WriteOp::Delete | WriteOp::Update) {
            let resolved = match self.lookup(table) {
                Some(Ty::Row(target)) => Some(target.clone()),
                _ => None,
            };
            let Some(target) = resolved else {
                let (message, rewrite) = match self.lookup(table) {
                    Some(Ty::Optional(inner)) if matches!(inner.as_ref(), Ty::Row(_)) => {
                        let Ty::Row(target) = inner.as_ref() else { unreachable!() };
                        (format!("{table} may be null; {} needs a present row", op.word()), format!("{table} = {target}[id] ! else NOT_FOUND, then {} {table}", op.word()))
                    }
                    Some(other) => (format!("{} {table} needs a row variable; {table} is {}", op.word(), other.name()), format!("{} t[{table}]", op.word())),
                    None if self.catalog.tables.contains_key(table.as_str()) => (format!("{} {table} names no row", op.word()), format!("{} {table}[id]{}", op.word(), if *op == WriteOp::Update { " { … }" } else { "" })),
                    None => (format!("unknown row variable {table}"), format!("bind it first: row = t[id] ! else NOT_FOUND, then {} row", op.word())),
                };
                return Err(unknown(site, message, rewrite));
            };
            let key = ast::KeyPart { column: None, value: A::Name { name: table.clone(), site: site.clone() }, site: site.clone() };
            let resolved = A::Write { op: *op, table: target, keys: vec![key], fields: fields.clone(), if_absent: *if_absent, condition: condition.clone(), site: site.clone() };
            return self.write_inner(&resolved, out, valued);
        }
        if self.in_prelude {
            return Err(placement(site, "a write belongs to a chunk", format!("move {} {table} inside a top-level `for row in table:` job sweep", op.word())));
        }
        if self.kind == ProgramKind::Query {
            return Err(Diagnostic::new(site, "E_QUARRY_PLACEMENT", format!("queries cannot {} {table}", op.word()), "move the write into a mutation").guide("programs"));
        }
        let info = self.table(table, site)?;
        if info.maintained.is_some() {
            return Err(unknown(site, format!("{table} is a maintained aggregate; write its source rows instead"), format!("{} {}", op.word(), info.maintained.as_ref().map(|m| m.source.clone()).unwrap_or_default())));
        }
        for field in fields {
            if info.decl.columns.iter().any(|c| c.name == field.name && c.sequence.is_some()) {
                return Err(Diagnostic::new(&field.site, "E_SEQUENCE_SUPPLIED", format!("{table}.{} is assigned by the engine", field.name),
                    format!("omit {} from the {} payload", field.name, op.word())).guide("writes"));
            }
            if super::columns::fields(info).any(|name|name == field.name) {
                return Err(super::columns::refusal(&field.site,format!("{table}.{} is engine-maintained; write its source rows instead",field.name)));
            }
        }
        self.system_principal_write(info, op, fields, *if_absent, site)?;
        self.note_denied_write(info, op, fields, site);
        // Writes share table-level residency facts, but every source occurrence
        // (including an expanded helper) belongs in a changed-prediction note.
        let write_name = format!("{} {table}", op.word());
        self.sources.insert(format!("write/{write_name}/{site}"), (site.clone(), write_name));
        match op {
            WriteOp::Insert => {
                let (row, row_ty) = self.write_row(info, fields, None, site, out)?;
                let row_ty = if self.schema.tables[table].column_reads.is_empty() || self.ordinary_write_lifetime(table) && self.row_independent_read_proved(table) { row_ty } else { row_ty.optional() };
                let tmp = self.temp("inserted");
                out.push(Stmt::Const { name: tmp.clone(), value: row });
                if *if_absent {
                    let result = self.temp("absent");
                    out.push(Stmt::InsertIfAbsent { table: table.clone(), row: ir::var(&tmp), result: result.clone() });
                    return Ok(valued.then(|| (self.project_insert(info, ir::var(&result)), row_ty.optional())));
                }
                out.push(Stmt::Insert { table: table.clone(), row: ir::var(&tmp) });
                Ok(valued.then(|| (self.project_insert(info, ir::var(&tmp)), row_ty)))
            }
            WriteOp::Update | WriteOp::Upsert => {
                // @ref LLP 3000.007#17 — upsert's insert arm has no old row on which to decide a condition.
                if *op == WriteOp::Upsert && condition.is_some() {
                    return Err(unknown(site, "upsert cannot take a condition", "a condition belongs on update; an upsert inserts or patches"));
                }
                // @ref LLP 3000.007#8 — item 7: target resolution and conditional old images belong to the engine.
                let key = self.write_key(info, keys, site, out).map_err(|error| self.extra_write_test(info, expr, error))?;
                let upsert = *op == WriteOp::Upsert;
                if upsert && fields.iter().any(|f| f.name == "id") {
                    return Err(unknown(site, "upsert cannot spell id; the key names the row", "remove id from the patch; the key names the row"));
                }
                let (patch, _) = self.write_row(info, fields, Some("patch"), site, out)?;
                self.immutable_patch(info, &key, &patch, fields, site, out, upsert, condition.is_some())?;
                let condition = if let Some(condition) = condition {
                    let old = self.temp("condition");
                    let prior = self.focal.replace((old.clone(), Ty::Row(table.clone())));
                    let mut setup = setup::Body::default();
            let mut setup = setup::Body::default();
            let (e, t) = self.insert_field_value(info, field, &expected, &mut setup)?;
            literal_in_range(info, &field.name, scalar, &e, &field.site)?;
            self.sequence_setup(exprs.iter_mut().map(|(_, e)| e), setup, out);
            if !t.writable_to(&expected) {
                return Err(diagnostics::write_field_type(info, field, &expected, &t));
            }
            let e = if expr::allocates(&e) { self.snapshot(e, out) } else { e };
            if !given.insert(field.name.clone()) {
                return Err(unknown(&field.site, format!("field {} is written twice", field.name), "keep one"));
            }
            exprs.push((field.name.clone(), e));
        }
        // Materialize the same defaults in the insert expression so its returned row is the written image.
        for column in &info.decl.columns {
            if !given.contains(&column.name) && let Some(default) = &column.default {
                if column.written_by.is_some() || self.schema.receipt_assigned(&info.decl.name, &column.name) {
                    // Preserve omission until the engine checks supplied-field authority.
                    given.insert(column.name.clone());
                    continue;
                }
                let default = super::defaults::column(column, default)?;
                let value = match default {
                    snapback4_core::schema::ColumnDefault::Literal(value) => Expr::Literal(value),
                    snapback4_core::schema::ColumnDefault::Now => Expr::Input(Input::Now),
                    snapback4_core::schema::ColumnDefault::Viewer => Expr::Input(Input::Viewer),
                };
                exprs.push((column.name.clone(), value));
                given.insert(column.name.clone());
            }
        }
        let missing: Vec<&str> = info.columns.iter().filter(|(name, scalar)| !scalar.optional && !self.schema.receipt_assigned(&info.decl.name, name) && !info.decl.columns.iter().any(|c| c.name == **name && c.sequence.is_some()) && !super::columns::fields(info).any(|f|f == *name) && !given.contains(*name)).map(|(name, _)| name.as_str()).collect();
        if !missing.is_empty() {
            return Err(type_error(site, format!("insert into {} omits required column{} {}", info.decl.name, if missing.len() == 1 { "" } else { "s" }, missing.join(", ")), format!("insert {} {{ {} }}", info.decl.name, given.iter().cloned().chain(missing.iter().map(|m| format!("{m}: <{}>", info.columns.get(*m).map(print::scalar_type).unwrap_or_default()))).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(", "))));
        }
        Ok((Expr::Object(exprs.into_iter().collect()), self.write_result_type(info)))
    }

    fn project_insert(&self, info: &TableInfo, row: Expr) -> Expr {
        if info.decl.columns.iter().any(|column| column.written_by.is_some()) || !self.schema.tables[&info.decl.name].column_reads.is_empty() {
            Expr::Builtin { builtin: Builtin::ProjectFields { table: info.decl.name.clone() }, args: vec![row] }
        } else { row }
    }

    fn write_result_type(&self, info: &TableInfo) -> Ty {
        if super::columns::fields(info).next().is_some() { Ty::WriteRow(info.decl.name.clone()) } else { Ty::Row(info.decl.name.clone()) }
    }

    fn calendar_number(&self, value: &A, depth: u8) -> bool {
        if depth > 8 { return false; }
        match value {
            A::Call { name, .. } => matches!(name.as_str(), "day" | "hour" | "bucket"),
            A::Name { name, .. } => self.binding(name).is_some_and(|binding| binding.revision == 0 && binding.origins.len() == 1 && self.calendar_number(&binding.origins[0].1, depth + 1)),
            A::If { then, otherwise, .. } => self.calendar_number(then, depth + 1) || self.calendar_number(otherwise, depth + 1),
            _ => false,
        }
    }

    fn field_value(&mut self, field: &ObjectField, expected: &Ty, out: &mut setup::Body) -> Fallible<(Expr, Ty)> {
        if expected.required() == Ty::Time && field.value.as_ref().map_or_else(
            || self.calendar_number(&A::Name { name: field.name.clone(), site: field.site.clone() }, 0), |value| self.calendar_number(value, 0)) {
//! Effective column payload audience; unresolved observer edges stay explicit.
use super::*;
// @ref LLP 3000.036.004#121-column-read-intent — a private owner gate narrows only the column payload.
pub(super) fn admission(table:&snapback4_core::schema::Table,column:Option<&str>)->RuleExpr{
    let mut rules=vec![super::temporal::admission(table)];
    if let Some(owner)=column.and_then(|c|table.written_by.get(c)).filter(|o|!o.audience){
        rules.push(RuleExpr::Eq(RuleTerm::Field(owner.owner.clone()),RuleTerm::Viewer));
    }
    if let Some(rule)=column.and_then(|c|table.column_reads.get(c)) { rules.push(rule.clone()); }
    RuleExpr::And(rules)
}

/// Every enforcement gate can confer authority or introduce a raw witness edge.
pub(super) fn rules(table:&snapback4_core::schema::Table)->impl Iterator<Item=&RuleExpr>{
    [&table.rules.read,&table.rules.insert,&table.rules.update,&table.rules.delete].into_iter().chain(table.column_reads.values())
}

/// Column effects carry effective row/owner authority, not a standalone cell gate.
pub(super) fn effects(table:&snapback4_core::schema::Table)->impl Iterator<Item=(String,RuleExpr)>+'_ {
    [("read".into(),table.rules.read.clone()),("insert".into(),table.rules.insert.clone()),("update".into(),table.rules.update.clone()),("delete".into(),table.rules.delete.clone())].into_iter()
        .chain(table.column_reads.keys().map(|column|(format!("{column} read"),admission(table,Some(column)))))
}
# Rules

**Snapback 2 optimizes the edit-to-verified loop — the agent's building an app on it, and ours building it.**

Speed is the constraint. Everything below exists to keep the edit-to-verified loop short
and to stop this repository accreting apparatus faster than anyone can remove it. These
rules bind `snapback2/` and the LLPs numbered 1000 and up; Snapback 1 is baselined, not
exempt, and its numbers may only fall.

Each rule is **[check]** (enforced by `caps`) or **[review]** (enforced by a human).

## Budgets — every budget is a trade, not a limit

- **5 blocking checks, 60s total.** A sixth requires deleting one, in the same PR. **[check]**
- **59 documents in the working set** (`llp/current/`). Today's count. A 60th requires
  archiving one — which is just removing the link. Snapback 2 aims to leave this at 15;
  Snapback 1's links are archived at promotion. **[check]**
- **12 documents in the foundation** (`llp/foundation/`). **[check]**
- **This file: 700 words.** If it grows, something becomes a check or stops being a rule. **[check]**
- **1,500 lines per source file, baseline 204.** Generated files exempt — and generated
  files are built, not committed; so are benchmark run records under `benchmarks/runs/`,
  which are evidence, not source. The baseline is Snapback 1's oversize count on the day
  the rule landed; it may not grow, and `snapback2/` contributes zero to it. **[check]**

## Blocking checks

`caps` · `ref-check` · `snapback2/scripts/test.sh` · `snapback2/scripts/measure.mjs --check` · `check-inventories`

## Loop shape

- **Every check reports all failures in one run.** Fail-fast is banned. **[check]**
- **Nothing blocks on anything slower than 60 seconds.** Slow verification runs on a
  schedule, attributed to the breaking commit, and files a bounded set of issues. **[review]**
- **Fix loops get 3 rounds.** Then stop: escalate to a human or descope. **[review]**

## Time budgets

Tracked every run of `snapback2/scripts/measure.mjs` (appends `snapback2/metrics/loop.jsonl`).
A regression is a P0 with a name on it.

| | budget |
|---|---|
| Incremental rebuild after a one-line edit | 15s |
| Test what you just changed | 30s |
| Blocking gate suite | 60s |
| Full build, warm cache | 5 min |
| **`snapback2 check` on a program (the agent's product latency)** | **1s** |
| **`snapback2 doctor` boot-to-ready** | **0.5s** |

## Scope

- **`NOT-DOING.md` is binding.** Moving something onto the doing-list means writing why
  and taking something off. **[review]**
- **Delete; don't deprecate.** No compat shims or migration paths before promotion. **[review]**
- **Nothing is compiled, transpiled, or generated at runtime that could be built ahead of
  time.** **[review]**
- **A spec needs an implementer and a date, or it isn't written.** **[review]**
- **Only implemented specs bind.** A document with no running code behind it is a
  proposal, and a proposal cannot block a PR or justify a check. **[review]**

## Agents

- **Agents remove apparatus freely and add none.** An agent PR that adds a check, script,
  registry, config file, or design doc needs explicit human approval saying so. **[review]**
- **2026-09-06 session exception:** the user delegated the search implementation
  decisions; one `snapback2-core/build.rs` may generate pinned Unicode tables at
  build time, alongside the existing package build. No new gate, registry,
  runtime generator, or Unicode dependency is authorized by this exception. **[review]**
- **Snapback 2 LLPs are numbered 1000 and up**; `llp-create` must be told. **[review]**
- **Snapback 4 LLPs are numbered 3000 and up** (`snapback4/`, LLP 3000); it adopts these budgets
  and loop shape as its own and keeps its scope in `snapback4/NOT-DOING.md`. **[review]**

## Shared machines

- Warm, named lanes, one per stream of work. Never clone fresh; reuse the worktree.
- **Never `git stash`.** Use a temporary commit.
- Kill only PIDs you recorded at launch. Never by name or pattern.

    pub fn compile(&self) -> std::io::Result<Bound> {

    /// Write `snapback/generated/api.ts` from a clean compile.
    pub fn write_generated(&self, bound: &Bound) -> std::io::Result<PathBuf> {
        self.write_generated_from(bound, self)
    }

    /// Resolve app-owned compatibility sources at their original project root,
    /// even when generated contracts belong to a private saved-source build.
    pub(crate) fn write_generated_from(&self, bound: &Bound, original: &Project) -> std::io::Result<PathBuf> {
        let dir = self.generated_dir();
        std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir)?;
        // @ref LLP 3000.036.004#103-adoption — draft is never part of compiled source discovery.
        let draft = dir.join("security-invariants.q.draft");
        let text = snapback4_lang::security::draft(bound);
        if std::fs::read_to_string(&draft).ok().as_deref() != Some(text.as_str()) {
            std::fs::write(draft, text)?;
        }
        let path = dir.join("api.ts");
        let text = crate::client_compatibility::typescript(original, bound)?;
        // @ref LLP 3000.007#20.2 — the generated API's ESM boundary is rebuilt with its artifacts, not imposed on existing scripts.
        let package = dir.join("package.json");
        if std::fs::read_to_string(&package).ok().as_deref() != Some(GENERATED_PACKAGE) {
            std::fs::write(package, GENERATED_PACKAGE)?;
        }
        if std::fs::read_to_string(&path).ok().as_deref() != Some(text.as_str()) {
            std::fs::write(&path, text)?;
        }
        let server = dir.join("server.ts");
        let text = snapback4_lang::emit::server_typescript(bound);
        if std::fs::read_to_string(&server).ok().as_deref() != Some(text.as_str()) {
            std::fs::write(server, text)?;
        }
        Ok(path)
    }

//! Authored write boundaries and compiler-typed committed mutation payloads.
// @ref LLP 3000.036.004#151-every-executed-write — no net-image inference for intermediate writes.
use super::*;
use snapback4_core::engine::fixture_trace::{Trace,Intent};
pub(super) fn trace(bound:&Bound,p:&Program)->Trace {
    Trace::new(bound.invariants.iter().filter(|inv|!matches!(inv.target.as_str(),"read"|"always")&&inv.operation.as_ref().is_none_or(|op|op==&p.name)).filter_map(|inv|Some(Intent{
        site:inv.site.to_string(),table:inv.table.clone(),column:inv.column.clone(),policy:inv.policy.clone()?,
        effects:super::super::effects(inv).iter().map(|word|super::super::effect(word)).collect(),
    })).collect())
}
pub(super) fn record(bound:&Bound,p:&Program,trace:&Trace,result:&snapback4_core::WriteState,after:&BTreeMap<String,Vec<Value>>,initial:&BTreeMap<String,Vec<Value>>,viewer:&str,steps:&[histories::Step],engine:&mut Engine,out:&mut Campaign){
    for observation in trace.take(){
        let Some(inv)=bound.invariants.iter().find(|inv|inv.site.to_string()==observation.site)else{continue;};
        match observation.allowed{
            Some(false)=>if let Some(row)=observation.next.as_ref().or(observation.old.as_ref()){
                if histories::violation(out,inv,steps,viewer,row,observation.old.as_ref(),initial,match observation.effect{Effect::Insert=>"insert",Effect::Update=>"update",Effect::Delete=>"delete",Effect::Read=>"read"}){
                    out.violations.last_mut().unwrap().rule_path="actual executed write boundary; independent policy false in the provisional transaction; enclosing authored mutation committed".into();
                }
            },
            None=>{out.unsupported.insert(format!("{} / {}: executed policy unknown; no refutation",p.name,inv.target_label()));},_=>{},
        }
    }
    let snapback4_core::WriteState::Sent{result:data,..}=result else{return;};
    let Some(bp)=bound.programs.iter().find(|bp|bp.program.name==p.name)else{return;};
    for inv in bound.invariants.iter().filter(|inv|inv.target=="read"){
        let Some(policy)=inv.policy.as_ref()else{continue;};
        let deps=stability::dependencies(bound,policy);
        let implicit=stability::implicit(bound,p);
        if implicit.contains(&inv.table)||implicit.iter().any(|t|deps.contains(t))||ir::write_tables(p).iter().any(|(t,_)|deps.contains(t)){
            out.unsupported.insert(format!("{} / {}: mutation-result policy changes require a disclosure-boundary reduction",p.name,inv.target_label()));continue;
        }
        for row in after.get(&inv.table).into_iter().flatten(){
            let Ok(key)=row.field("id")else{continue;};
            if !histories::typed_disclosure(&bp.result,data,&inv.table,key,inv.column.as_deref(),row){continue;}
            if !histories::typed_disclosure_image(&bp.result,data,&inv.table,key,inv.column.as_deref(),row,Some(policy)){
                out.unsupported.insert(format!("{} / {}: returned policy image differs from committed image; disclosure boundary uncovered",p.name,inv.target_label()));continue;
            }
            if !out.reserve(1){return;}
            if policy_in(bound,inv,after,viewer,None,row,engine)!=Ok(false){continue;}
            if histories::violation(out,inv,steps,viewer,row,None,initial,"mutation result"){
                let v=out.violations.last_mut().unwrap();v.operation=p.name.clone();v.args=steps.last().map(|s|s.args.clone()).unwrap_or_default();v.rule_path="authored mutation returned a compiler-typed protected row/column payload; stable current policy false".into();
            }
        }
    }
}

// Follow an actually admitted state change with payload-bearing operations on
// the same referenced row. This finds lifecycle-to-mutation observations without
// spending pair slots on unrelated roster and creation combinations.
pub(super) fn pairs(bound:&Bound,candidates:&[(&Program,String,BTreeMap<String,Value>)],committed:&[usize])->Vec<(usize,usize)>{
    let protected=bound.invariants.iter().filter(|i|i.target=="read").map(|i|i.table.clone()).collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
    let mut groups:BTreeMap<(String,String),Vec<(usize,usize)>>=BTreeMap::new();let mut seen=BTreeSet::new();
    for (second,(p,actor,args)) in candidates.iter().enumerate(){
        let Some(bp)=bound.programs.iter().find(|bp|bp.program.name==p.name)else{continue;};
        for &first in committed{
            let (before,who,inputs)=&candidates[first];if before.name==p.name{continue;}
            let shared=protected.iter().any(|table|histories::typed_source(&bp.result,table)&&ir::write_tables(before).iter().any(|(t,_)|t==table)&&before.args.iter().any(|(a,k)|matches!(k,ir::ArgType::Ref{table:t} if t==table)&&p.args.iter().any(|(b,k)|matches!(k,ir::ArgType::Ref{table:t} if t==table)&&inputs.get(a)==args.get(b))));
            if shared&&seen.insert((before.name.clone(),who.clone(),p.name.clone(),actor.clone())){groups.entry((p.name.clone(),actor.clone())).or_default().push((first,second));}
        }
    }
    let mut out=Vec::new();for n in 0..groups.values().map(Vec::len).max().unwrap_or(0){for group in groups.values(){if let Some(pair)=group.get(n){out.push(*pair);if out.len()==256{return out;}}}}out
}

// Identify direct argument supplies to declared column-write intent. This only
// prioritizes proposals; actual interpreter admission still decides every case.
pub(super) fn write_arguments(bound:&Bound,p:&Program)->BTreeSet<String>{
    fn walk(v:&serde_json::Value,f:&mut impl FnMut(&serde_json::Value)){
        f(v);match v{serde_json::Value::Object(xs)=>for x in xs.values(){walk(x,f)},serde_json::Value::Array(xs)=>for x in xs{walk(x,f)},_=>{}}
    }
    let json=serde_json::to_value(p).unwrap();let mut bindings=BTreeMap::new();
    walk(&json,&mut |v|for tag in ["Const","Let"]{if let Some(b)=v.get(tag)&&let(Some(n),Some(e))=(b.get("name").and_then(|v|v.as_str()),b.get("value")){bindings.insert(n.to_string(),e.clone());}});
    fn resolve<'a>(v:&'a serde_json::Value,bindings:&'a BTreeMap<String,serde_json::Value>,depth:usize)->&'a serde_json::Value{
        if depth>32{return v;}if let Some(n)=v.get("Variable").and_then(|v|v.as_str())&&let Some(e)=bindings.get(n){resolve(e,bindings,depth+1)}else{v}
    }
    let mut out=BTreeSet::new();
    walk(&json,&mut |v|for tag in ["Insert","InsertIfAbsent","Upsert","Update","WriteTarget"]{
        let Some(w)=v.get(tag)else{continue;};let table=w.get("table").or_else(||w.get("target").and_then(|t|t.get("table"))).and_then(|v|v.as_str());
        let Some(payload)=w.get("row").or_else(||w.get("patch"))else{continue;};let payload=resolve(payload,&bindings,0);
        let Some(fields)=payload.get("Object").and_then(|v|v.as_object())else{continue;};
        for inv in bound.invariants.iter().filter(|i|Some(i.table.as_str())==table&&i.column.is_some()&&!matches!(i.target.as_str(),"read"|"always")&&i.operation.as_ref().is_none_or(|op|op==&p.name)){
            if let Some(value)=fields.get(inv.column.as_ref().unwrap())&&let Some(arg)=resolve(value,&bindings,0).get("Variable").and_then(|v|v.as_str())&&p.args.contains_key(arg){out.insert(arg.into());}
        }
    });out
}
//! Author-owned intent starts with a reviewable draft, never inferred policy.
// @ref LLP 3000.036.004#103-adoption — syntactic coverage is distinct from a proved invariant.
use super::*;

pub(super) fn missing(bound:&Bound)->Vec<String>{
    bound.schema.visible_tables().filter(|(name,t)| {
        ([&t.rules.read,&t.rules.insert,&t.rules.update,&t.rules.delete].iter().any(|r|!matches!(r,RuleExpr::Deny)) || !t.written_by.is_empty())
            && !bound.invariants.iter().any(|i| &i.table==*name)
    }).map(|(name,_)|name.clone()).collect()
}

/// Specification questions, never proposed enforcement or accepted policy.
/// The caller must keep this outside the compiled .q source set.
pub fn draft(bound:&Bound)->String{
    let mut out=String::from("-- DRAFT: NOT ACCEPTED. Answer from the APP SPECIFICATION, not from the rules.\n-- Each answer needs an audience, a resource relationship and lifecycle/consent conditions.\n-- Use table-read intent for a shared row audience; add column-read intent for distinct privacy boundaries.\n-- Assess every role and column, without automatically declaring one invariant for each question.\n-- Identify each role's positive product/workflow grant before retaining access to other people's private data.\n-- Write confirmed declarations in authored snapback/*.q, then run check -> test -> audit.\n-- This questionnaire is never compiled and does not propose policy.\n-- snapback4 guide security\n\n");
    let roles=super::intent::roles(bound);
    for (name,t) in bound.schema.visible_tables(){
        out.push_str(&format!("-- {name}: {}\n",super::intent::row_context(t)));
        let audiences=std::iter::once("a signed-in user without a roster role (check own rows and unrelated rows separately)".to_owned())
            .chain(roles.iter().cloned()).collect::<Vec<_>>();
        for audience in &audiences {
            out.push_str(&format!("-- Q {name}.write / {audience}: may any user of this role write ANY {name} row, or only the owner of THIS resource? Which relationship and state must hold?\n"));
            out.push_str(&format!("-- Q {name}.read / {audience}: which rows may this audience see according to the spec? Own, assigned, team-wide, or none? Which state/consent conditions must hold now?\n"));
        }
        for (column,kind) in &t.columns {
            if column=="id"||t.engine_field(column){continue;}
            for audience in &audiences {
                out.push_str(&format!("-- Q {name}.{column} ({kind}) / {audience}: may this audience read this value, including downloads and derived values? On which related rows and in which states? If not, which independently confirmed column-read invariant excludes it?\n"));
            }
        }
        for inv in bound.invariants.iter().filter(|i|i.table==*name&&i.column.is_some()&&i.target=="update"){
            out.push_str(&format!("-- {}: update-only intent excludes creation. Does the specification allow callers to supply this column at insert/upsert too? Use write only if creation shares the restriction.\n",inv.target_label()));
        }
        for effect in ["insert","update","delete"] {
            if covered(bound,name,effect){continue;}
            out.push_str(&format!("-- Q {name}.{effect}: who may {effect}, who appoints that authority, and which relationship/state must hold? Can callers claim the relationship themselves?\n"));
        }
        for (column,authority) in &t.written_by {out.push_str(&format!("-- Q {name}.{column}: may .{} edit this value in every state? Column update intent covers edits; write also covers creation.\n",authority.owner));}
        out.push('\n');
    }
    out
}

fn covered(bound:&Bound,table:&str,effect:&str)->bool{
    bound.invariants.iter().any(|i|i.table==table && i.operation.is_none() && i.column.is_none()
        && (i.target==effect || i.target=="write" && matches!(effect,"insert"|"update")))
}
#[derive(Clone,Debug,Serialize)]
pub struct UncoveredExposure {pub table:String,pub effect:String,pub audience:String,pub row_predicate:String,pub column:Option<String>}
pub(super) fn uncovered(bound:&Bound,exposures:&[Exposure])->Vec<UncoveredExposure>{
    let mut out=exposures.iter().flat_map(|x|x.effects.iter().filter(|(effect,rule)|rule.as_str()!="deny"&&!covered(bound,&x.table,effect)).map(|(effect,predicate)|UncoveredExposure{
        table:x.table.clone(),effect:effect.clone(),audience:if predicate=="allow"||predicate.starts_with("public"){"every signed-in user".into()}else{format!("caller satisfying {predicate}")},row_predicate:predicate.clone(),column:None,
    })).collect::<Vec<_>>();
    for (name,t) in bound.schema.visible_tables(){for (column,authority) in &t.written_by{
        if covered(bound,name,"update")||bound.invariants.iter().any(|i|i.table==*name&&i.operation.is_none()&&i.column.as_ref()==Some(column)&&matches!(i.target.as_str(),"write"|"update")){continue;}
        out.push(UncoveredExposure{table:name.clone(),effect:"update".into(),column:Some(column.clone()),audience:format!("owner .{} = viewer",authority.owner),row_predicate:format!("field-owner patch authority for {column}; table update rule may deny")});
    }}out
}

fn statements(bound:&Bound,body:&[Stmt],env:&mut BTreeMap<String,Flow>,reads:&mut BTreeSet<String>,returned:&mut Sources,refusals:&mut Sources){for s in body{match s{
    Stmt::Const{name,value:e}|Stmt::Let{name,value:e}|Stmt::Assign{name,value:e}=>{let f=value(bound,e,env,reads,returned,refusals);env.insert(name.clone(),f);},
    Stmt::Push{target,value:e}=>{let f=value(bound,e,env,reads,returned,refusals);let old=env.remove(target).unwrap_or_default();env.insert(target.clone(),Flow::union([old,f]));},
    Stmt::Insert{table,row:Expr::Variable(n)}|Stmt::InsertIfAbsent{table,row:Expr::Variable(n),..}=>{let prior=env.remove(n).unwrap_or_default();env.insert(n.clone(),Flow::join(prior,row(bound,table)));},
    Stmt::WriteTarget{target,result:Some(n),..}=>{reads.insert(target.table.clone());env.insert(n.clone(),row(bound,&target.table));},
    Stmt::Return(e)=>{returned.extend(value(bound,e,env,reads,&mut Sources::new(),refusals).all());},
    Stmt::Require{condition,..}|Stmt::Check{condition,..}=>{refusals.extend(value(bound,condition,env,reads,returned,&mut Sources::new()).all());},
    Stmt::If{condition,then_body,else_body}=>{
        let condition=value(bound,condition,env,reads,returned,refusals).all();
        // A private branch can choose both results and authored refusals.
        returned.extend(condition.iter().cloned());refusals.extend(condition);
        let mut other=env.clone();statements(bound,then_body,env,reads,returned,refusals);statements(bound,else_body,&mut other,reads,returned,refusals);
        for (n,f) in other{let old=env.remove(&n).unwrap_or_default();env.insert(n,Flow::join(old,f));}
    },
    Stmt::For{binding,domain,body}=>{match domain{
        ir::LoopDomain::Page(s)=>{reads.insert(s.table.clone());env.insert(binding.clone(),row(bound,&s.table));},
        ir::LoopDomain::DerivedArray{value:e,..}=>{let f=value(bound,e,env,reads,returned,refusals);env.insert(binding.clone(),f);},_=>{},
    }statements(bound,body,env,reads,returned,refusals);},_=>{},
}}}

I found a concrete lineage gap in `insert … if absent`: the analyzer updates the input row temporary, but the compiler returns a separate result temporary. A copied private column can therefore disappear from the grouped exposure advice. I’m checking the lowering and regression coverage to pin down the finding.
